They were divided off and established in Kaiyuan 26. Tai Prefecture, upper grade: Sui Linhai in Yongjia commandery. Wude 4: Li Zitong pacified; Hai with five counties.
94
五年，改為台州。 六年，沒於輔公祏。 七年平賊，仍置台州，省寧海入章安。 八年，廢始豐、樂安二縣入臨海， 貞觀八年，復分置始豐。 舊管二縣， 永昌元年，置寧海縣。神龍二年，置象山縣。天寶元年，改為臨海郡。乾元元年，復為台州。 舊領縣二：臨海、始豐。 戶六千五百八十三，口三萬五千三百八十三。 天寶領縣六，戶八萬三千八百六十八，口四十八萬九千一十五。 在京師東南四千一百七十七里，至東都三千三百三十里。
Wude 5: Tai Prefecture. Wude 6: fell to Fu Gongshi. Wude 7: rebels pacified; Tai restored; Ninghai into Zhang'an. Wude 8: Shifeng and Le'an into Linhai. In the eighth year of Zhenguan, Shifeng again split and established. Formerly two counties. Ninghai County was established in Yongchang 1, and Xiangshan County in Shenlong 2. In Tianbao 1 it became Linhai Commandery; in Qianyuan 1 it was restored as Tai Prefecture. Formerly Linhai and Shifeng. 6,583 households, 35,383 mouths. Tianbao: six counties, 83,868 households, 489,015 mouths. 4,177 li southeast of the capital, 3,330 li from Luoyang.
95
漢回浦縣，屬會稽郡。 後漢改為章安。 吳分章安置臨海縣， 武德四年，於縣置台州，取天臺山為名 吳始平縣，晉改始豐，隋末廢。武德四年，復置。
Linhai: Han Huipu, Kuaiji commandery. Later Han: Zhang'an. Wu split Zhang'an for Linhai. In Wude 4, Tai Prefecture was set up at the county and named for Mount Tiantai. Originally Wu Shiping County, it was renamed Shifeng under the Jin and abolished at the end of the Sui. In Wude 4 it was restored.
96
八年，又廢， 貞觀八年，復為始豐縣。上元二年，改為唐興 上元二年，分臨海置 廢縣。上元二年，分臨海置，徙治孟溪 永昌元年，分臨海置 神龍二年，分寧海及越州鄮縣置。 隋東陽郡。武德四年，平李子通，置婺州，領華川、長山二縣。
Wude 8: again abolished. In the eighth year of Zhenguan, it was restored as Shifeng County. In the second year of Shangyuan, it was renamed Tangxing. In the second year of Shangyuan, it was established by splitting Linhai. A former county. In the second year of Shangyuan, it was established by splitting Linhai, and its seat was moved to Meng Creek. In the first year of Yongchang, it was established by splitting Linhai. In the second year of Shenlong, it was established by splitting Ninghai and Mao County of Yue Prefecture. In Sui times this was Dongyang Commandery. In the fourth year of Wude, after Li Zitong was pacified, Wu Prefecture was established, governing Huachuan and Changshan counties.
100
七年，廢綱州，義烏來屬。 八年，廢麗州為永康縣、衢州信安縣，並來屬。 又廢谷州入信安，長山入金華縣， 貞觀八年，復置龍丘縣。咸亨五年，置蘭溪、常山二縣。垂拱二年，分龍丘、信安、常山三縣置衢州，又置東陽縣。天授二年，又置武義縣。天寶元年，改婺州為東陽郡。乾元元年，復為婺州。 舊領縣五，戶三萬七千八百一十九，口二十二萬八千九百九十。 天寶領縣七，戶十四萬四千八十六，口七十萬七千一百五十二。 在京師東南四千七十三里，至東都三千一百三十五里。
Wude 7: Gang abolished; Yiwu here. Wude 8: Li to Yongkang; Qu's Xin'an; both here. Gu abolished into Xin'an; Changshan into Jinhua. In Zhenguan 8, Longqiu County was restored. In Xianheng 5, Lanxi and Changshan were created. In Chuigong 2, Qu Prefecture was formed from Longqiu, Xin'an, and Changshan, and Dongyang County was also established. In Tianshou 2, Wuyi County was added. In Tianbao 1, Wu became Dongyang Commandery; in Qianyuan 1, it returned to Wu Prefecture. Formerly five counties, 37,819 households, 228,990 mouths. Tianbao: seven counties, 144,086 households, 707,152 mouths. 4,073 li southeast of the capital, 3,135 li from Luoyang.
101
漢烏傷縣，屬會稽郡。 後漢分烏傷置長山縣。 吳置東陽郡。 隋改長山為金華，取州界山為名 晉分烏傷縣置。武德四年，置綱州，仍分置華川縣。七年，廢綱州及華川縣，改烏傷為義烏，以縣屬婺州 吳分烏傷縣置。武德四年，置麗州，又分置縉雲縣。八年，廢麗州及縉雲縣，以永康來屬 垂拱二年，分烏傷縣，取舊郡名。蘭溪咸亨五年，析金華縣西界置，以溪水為名。武成天授二年，分永康置武義縣，又改為武成 新置。 武德四年，平李子通，于信安縣置衢州。
Jinhua: Han Wushang, Kuaiji commandery. Later Han split Wushang for Changshan. Wu established Dongyang commandery. Sui: Changshan to Jinhua, from a prefectural mountain. Jin split from Wushang. Wude 4: Gang Prefecture; Huachuan split. Wude 7: Gang and Huachuan abolished; Wushang to Yiwu; to Wu. Wu split from Wushang. Wude 4: Li Prefecture; Jinyun split. Wude 8: Li and Jinyun abolished; Yongkang here. In Chuigong 2, it was created from Wushang and took the old commandery name. Lanxi was created in Xianheng 5 from western Jinhua and named for the stream. In Tianshou 2, Wuyi County was created from Yongkang and later renamed Wucheng. Newly established. Wude 4: Li Zitong pacified; Qu at Xin'an.
105
七年陷賊，乃廢， 垂拱二年，分婺州之信安、龍丘置衢州，取武德廢州名。天寶元年，改為信安郡。乾元元年，復為衢州，又割常山入信州。 天寶領縣五，戶六萬八千四百七十二，口四十四萬四百一十一。 在京師東南四千七百十三里，至東都三千一百四十五里。
Wude 7: fell to rebels; abolished. In Chuigong 2, Qu Prefecture was created from Wu Prefecture's Xin'an and Longqiu, reusing the name of the prefecture abolished in Wude. In Tianbao 1 it became Xin'an Commandery. In Qianyuan 1 it returned to Qu Prefecture, and Changshan was transferred to Xin Prefecture. Tianbao: five counties, 68,472 households, 440,411 mouths. 4,713 li southeast of the capital, 3,145 li from Luoyang.
106
後漢新安縣，晉改為信安， 武德四年，置衢州，縣仍屬焉。 又分置須江、定陽二縣。 八年，廢衢州及須江、定陽二縣，以信安還屬婺州
Xin'an: Later Han county; Jin Xin'an. Wude 4: Qu established; county subordinate. Xujiang and Dingyang also split off. Wude 8: Qu, Xujiang, Dingyang abolished; Xin'an to Wu.
107
漢太末縣，屬會稽郡。 晉置龍丘縣，以山為名。 至隋廢， 武德四年，置穀州及太末、白石二縣。 八年，廢谷州及白石、太末二縣入信安縣， 貞觀八年，分金華、信安二縣置龍丘縣，來屬婺州。垂拱二年，躭衢州 武德四年，分信安置，以城南有須江。八年廢，永昌元年，分信安復置。 如意元年，分龍丘置，縣西有刑溪，陳時土人留異惡「刑」字，改名盈川，因以為縣名。 咸亨五年，分信安置，屬婺州。垂拱二年，改屬衢州。乾元元年，屬信州，又還衢州。 信州上乾元元年，割衢州之常山、饒州之弋陽、建州之三鄉、撫州之一鄉，置信州，又置上饒、永豐二縣。
Longqiu: Han Taimo, Kuaiji commandery. Jin established Longqiu, named for the mountain. Abolished by the Sui. Wude 4: Gu Prefecture; Taimo and Baishi. Wude 8: Gu abolished; Baishi and Taimo into Xin'an. In the eighth year of Zhenguan, Longqiu County was established by splitting Jinhua and Xin'an counties and came under Wu Prefecture. In the second year of Chuigong, it came under Qu Prefecture. In the fourth year of Wude, it was established by splitting Xin'an, named for the Xu River south of the city. In the eighth year it was abolished; in the first year of Yongchang, it was re-established by splitting Xin'an. In the first year of Ruyi, it was established by splitting Longqiu. West of the county was Xing Creek; during the Chen period, the local notable Liu Yi disliked the character "刑", so it was renamed Yingchuan and the county took this as its name. In the fifth year of Xianheng, it was established by splitting Xin'an and placed under Wu Prefecture. In the second year of Chuigong, it was transferred to Qu Prefecture. In the first year of Qianyuan, it belonged to Xin Prefecture, then returned to Qu Prefecture. Xin Prefecture, upper grade: in the first year of Qianyuan, Changshan from Qu Prefecture, Yiyang from Rao Prefecture, three townships from Jian Prefecture, and one township from Fu Prefecture were detached to establish Xin Prefecture, with Shangrao and Yongfeng counties also created.
110
領縣四，戶四萬。 在京師東南五千八百里，至東都二千九百五十里。
Four counties, 40,000 households. 5,800 li southeast of the capital, 2,950 li from Luoyang.
111
乾元元年置，州所理也。元和七年，省永豐縣入 舊屬饒州，乾元元年，來屬。 永泰元年十一月，分弋陽西界置。
Shangrao: prefectural seat. Yongfeng abolished and merged in. Formerly Rao; Zhenguan 4 assigned here. In the eleventh month of Yongtai 1, it was created from western Yiyang.
113
玉山證聖二年，分常山、須江置，屬衢州， 乾元元年，割屬信州。 隋遂安郡。武德四年，平汪華，改為睦州，領雉山、遂安二縣。 七年，廢嚴州之桐廬縣來屬，又改為東睦州。 八年，去「東」字。 舊管縣三，治雉山， 萬歲登封二年，移治建德。天寶元年，改為新定郡。乾元元年，復為睦州。 舊領縣三：雉山、遂安、桐廬。 戶一萬二千六十四，口五萬九千六十八。 天寶領縣六，戶五萬四千九百六十一，口三十八萬二千五百一十三。 在京師東南三千六百五十九里，至東都二千八百三十一里。
Yushan: Zhengsheng 2 from Changshan and Xujiang; subordinate to Qu. Zhenguan 3: detached to Xin. Mu Prefecture: Sui Sui'an commandery. Wude 4: Wang Hua pacified; Mu with Zhishan and Sui'an. Wude 7: Yan's Tonglu here; Eastern Mu Prefecture. In the eighth year of Wude, the character "東" was dropped. Formerly three counties, seat at Zhishan. In Wansui Dengfeng 2, the seat moved to Jiande. In Tianbao 1 it became Xinding Commandery, and in Qianyuan 1 it was restored as Mu Prefecture. Formerly Zhishan, Sui'an, Tonglu. 12,064 households, 59,068 mouths. Tianbao: six counties, 54,961 households, 382,513 mouths. 3,659 li southeast of the capital, 2,831 li from Luoyang.
114
漢富春縣地，屬會稽郡。 吳分置建德縣，隋廢， 永淳二年，復分桐廬、雉山置。萬歲通天二年，移州治建德縣 漢歙縣地，屬丹陽郡。
Jiande: Han Fuchun territory, Kuaiji commandery. Wu established Jiande; Sui abolished. Wude 7: re-established from Tonglu and Zhishan. Zhenguan 1: seat moved to Jiande. Zhishan: Han She territory, Danyang commandery.
115
後分置新安縣，隋改為雉山， 文明元年，復為新安。開元二十年，改為還淳。永貞元年十二月，避憲宗名，改為清溪。舊為睦州治所，移建德 永昌元年七月，分雉山縣置。載初元年廢，神龍元年復。
Later split Xin'an; Sui Zhishan. In Wenming 1, it was restored as Xin'an. In Kaiyuan 20, it was renamed Huanchun. In the twelfth month of Yongzhen 1, it was renamed Qingxi to avoid Emperor Xianzong's taboo name. It had formerly been Mu Prefecture's seat before the move to Jiande. Changqing 2, seventh month: Qingxi split from Zhishan. Abolished; restored.
116
舊治白艾裏，後移於今所。 桐廬吳分富春縣置， 武德四年，于縣置嚴州，領桐廬、分水、建德三縣。 七年，廢州及分水、建德二縣。 以桐廬屬睦州。 舊治桐溪，開元二十六年，移治鐘山 如意元年，分桐廬縣之四鄉，置武盛縣。神龍元年，改為分水 後漢分歙縣南鄉安定里，置新定縣。
Former seat Baiai; later present site. Tonglu: Wu split from Fuchun. Wude 4: Yan at county; Tonglu, Fenshui, Jiande. Wude 7: Yan abolished; Fenshui and Jiande abolished. Tonglu to Mu Prefecture. Its old seat was at Tong Creek. In Kaiyuan 26, the seat moved to Zhongshan. In Ruyi 1, four townships of Tonglu were used to create Wusheng County. In Shenlong 1, it was renamed Fenshui. Later Han: southern She, Anding; Xinding.
118
晉改新定為遂安。 隋新安郡。武德四年，平汪華，置歙州總管，管歙、睦、衢三州。貞觀元年，罷都督府。天寶元年，改為新安郡。乾元元年，復為歙州。 舊領縣三，戶六千二十一，口二萬六千六百一十七。 天寶領縣五，戶三萬八千三百三十，口二十六萬九千一百九。 在京師東南三千六百六十七里，至東都二千八百二十六里。
Jin: Xinding to Sui'an. She Prefecture: Sui Xin'an Commandery. In Wude 4, after Wang Hua was pacified, a Shezhou protectorate supervised She, Mu, and Qu. The protectorate was abolished in Zhenguan 1. In Tianbao 1 it became Xin'an Commandery, and in Qianyuan 1 it returned to She Prefecture. Formerly three counties, 6,021 households, 26,617 mouths. Tianbao: five counties, 38,330 households, 269,190 mouths. 3,667 li southeast of the capital, 2,826 li from Luoyang.
119
漢縣，屬丹陽郡。 縣南有歙浦，因為名。 隋於縣置新安郡。 武德改為歙州。
Jurong: Han county, Danyang commandery. South is She Creek, source of the name. Sui Xin'an commandery at the county. Wude: She Prefecture.
120
吳分歙縣置休陽縣，後改為海陽。 晉武改為海甯，隋改為休寧。 黟漢縣，屬丹陽郡。 音同醫，縣南墨嶺山出石墨故也。 縣置在黟川，
Wu split She for Xiuyang; later Haiyang. Jin Wu: Haining; Sui: Xiuning. Yi: Han county, Danyang commandery. Pronounced yi; Mount Moling south produces graphite, hence the name. Seat on the Yi River.
121
永徽五年，分置北野縣，後改為績溪。 開元二十八年正月九日置。 隋永嘉郡。武德四年，平李子通，置括州，置總管府，管松、嘉、台三州。
In Yonghui 5, Beiye County was created and later renamed Jixi. It was established on the ninth day of the first month of Kaiyuan 28. Chu Prefecture: Sui Yongjia commandery — not the state of Chu. Wude 4: Li Zitong pacified; Kuo with protectorate over Song, Jia, Tai.
122
括州領括蒼、麗水二縣。 七年，改為都督府。 八年，廢松州為松陽縣來屬。 省麗水入括蒼， 貞觀元年，廢都督府。 省東嘉州，以永嘉、安固二縣來屬， 天寶元年，改為縉雲郡。乾元元年，復為括州。大曆十四年夏五月，改為處州，避德宗諱。 舊領縣四，戶一萬二千八百九十九，口十萬一千六百六。 天寶領縣五，戶四萬二千九百三十六，口二十五萬八千二百四十八。 今縣六。 在京師東南四千二百七十八里，至東都三千一十五里。
Kuo governed Kuocang and Lishui. Wude 7: protectorate-general. Wude 8: Song to Songyang, assigned here. Lishui abolished into Kuocang. Zhenguan 1: protectorate abolished. Eastern Jia abolished; Yongjia and Angu here. In Tianbao 1 it became Jinyun Commandery. In Qianyuan 1 it returned to Kuo Prefecture. In the fifth month of summer in Dali 14, it was renamed Chu Prefecture to avoid Emperor Dezong's taboo. Formerly four counties, 12,899 households, 101,606 mouths. Tianbao: five counties, 42,936 households, 258,248 mouths. Now six counties. 4,278 li southeast of the capital, 3,015 li from Luoyang.
123
漢回浦縣地，屬會稽郡。 光武更為章安。 隋平陳，改永嘉郡為處州，尋改為括州，又分松陽縣東界置括蒼縣。 大曆十四年夏，改為麗水縣，州所治 後漢分章安之南鄉置松陽縣，縣東南大陽及松樹為名 萬歲登封元年，分括蒼及婺州永康縣置 景雲二年，分括蒼置 舊縣。武德八年，併入松陽。景雲二年，分松陽縣復置 乾元二年，越州刺史獨孤嶼奏請于括州龍泉鄉置縣，以龍泉為名，從之。 ，上，隋永嘉郡之永嘉縣。武德五年，置東嘉州，領永嘉、永甯、安固、樂成、橫陽五縣。貞觀元年，廢東嘉州，以縣屬括州。上元二年，分括州之永嘉、安固二縣置溫州。天寶元年，改為永嘉郡。乾元元年，復為溫州。
Kuocang: Han Huipu, Kuaiji commandery. Guangwu: Zhang'an again. Sui pacified Chen; Yongjia to Chu then Kuo; eastern Songyang split for Kuocang. In the summer of the fourteenth year of Dali, it was renamed Lishui County and became the prefectural seat. Later Han split off the southern township of Zhang'an to establish Songyang County; it was named for Dayang and the pine trees southeast of the county. In the first year of Wansui Dengfeng, it was established by splitting Kuocang and Yongkang County of Wu Prefecture. In the second year of Jingyun, it was established by splitting Kuocang. A former county. In the eighth year of Wude, it was merged into Songyang. In the second year of Jingyun, it was re-established by splitting Songyang County. In the second year of Qianyuan, Dugu Yu, prefect of Yue Prefecture, memorialized requesting that a county be established at Longquan Township of Kuo Prefecture and named Longquan; this was approved. Wen Prefecture, upper grade: under the Sui, this was Yongjia County of Yongjia Commandery. In the fifth year of Wude, Eastern Jia Prefecture was established, governing Yongjia, Yongning, Angu, Lecheng, and Hengyang counties. In the first year of Zhenguan, Eastern Jia Prefecture was abolished and the county was placed under Kuo Prefecture. In the second year of Shangyuan, Yongjia and Angu counties of Kuo Prefecture were split off to establish Wen Prefecture. In the first year of Tianbao, it was renamed Yongjia Commandery. In the first year of Qianyuan, it again became Wen Prefecture.
128
天寶領縣四，戶四萬二千八百一十四，口二十四萬一千六百九十四。 在京師東南四千七百三十七里，至東都三千九百四十里。
Tianbao: four counties, 42,814 households, 241,694 mouths. 4,737 li southeast of the capital, 3,940 li from Luoyang.
129
後漢分章安縣之東甌鄉置永寧縣，屬會稽郡。 晉置永嘉郡。 隋改為永嘉， 上元二年，置溫州，治於北縣 後漢章安縣，晉改為安固，隋廢。武德八年，分永嘉縣置，屬東嘉州。貞觀元年，廢東嘉州，安固屬括州。上元元年，屬溫州 武德五年，分安固縣置。貞觀元年廢，大足元年，復分安固置 武德五年置，七年併入永嘉縣。載初元年，分永嘉復置也。 福州，中都督府，隋建安郡之閩縣。
Later Han: Dong'ou of Zhang'an; Yongning, Kuaiji. Jin: Yongjia commandery. Sui: Yongjia. In the second year of Shangyuan, Wen Prefecture was established, with its seat at Bei County. Later Han Zhang'an County was renamed Angu under Jin and abolished under the Sui. In the eighth year of Wude, it was established by splitting Yongjia County and belonged to Eastern Jia Prefecture. In the first year of Zhenguan, Eastern Jia Prefecture was abolished and Angu belonged to Kuo Prefecture. In the first year of Shangyuan, it belonged to Wen Prefecture. In the fifth year of Wude, it was established by splitting Angu County. It was abolished in the first year of Zhenguan, and in the first year of Dazu it was again established by splitting Angu. It was established in the fifth year of Wude and merged into Yongjia County in the seventh year. In the first year of Zaichu, it was re-established by splitting Yongjia. Fu Prefecture, middle protectorate: Sui Min in Jian'an commandery.
132
貞觀初，置泉州， 景雲二年，改為閩州，置都督府，督閩、泉、建、漳、湖五州。開元十三年，改為福州，依舊都督府，仍置經略使。 二十二年，罷漳、湖二州，令督福、建、泉、汀四州。 舊屬嶺南道，天寶初，改屬江南東道。 尋改為長樂郡， 乾元元年，復為福州都督府。 天寶領縣八，戶三萬四千八十四，口七萬五千八百七十六。 在京師東南五千三十三里，至東都四千二百三十三里。
Early Zhenguan: Quan Prefecture. Zhenguan 5: Min Prefecture; protectorate over five prefectures. Zhenguan 6: Fu Prefecture; protectorate kept; frontier commissioner. Zhenguan 22: Zhang and Hu abolished; supervised Fu, Jian, Quan, Ting. Formerly Lingnan; early Tianbao: Eastern Jiangnan. Soon: Changle commandery. In Qianyuan 1, it again became the Fu Prefecture protectorate. Tianbao: eight counties, 34,084 households, 75,876 mouths. 5,033 li southeast of the capital, 4,233 li from Luoyang.
133
漢冶縣，屬會稽郡。 秦時為閩中郡。 漢高立閩越王，都於此。 武帝誅東越，徙其人于江淮，空其地。 其逃亡者，自立為冶縣，後更名東冶縣。 後漢改為侯官都尉，屬會稽郡。 晉置晉安郡。 宋、齊因之，陳置閩州，又改為豐州。 隋平陳改為泉州，煬帝改為閩州，又為建安郡， 開元十三年，改為福州。皆治閩縣 隋縣。
Min: Han Ye, Kuaiji commandery. Qin: Minzhong commandery. Han Gaozu enfeoffed Minyue here. Wu executed Eastern Yue; people to Jianghuai; land emptied. Fugitives established Ye County; later Dongye. Later Han: Houguan commandant, Kuaiji. Jin: Jin'an commandery. Song and Qi unchanged; Chen Min then Feng. Sui pacified Chen: Quan; Yang Min then Jian'an commandery. Zhenguan 6: Fu Prefecture. All administered from Min. Sui county.
134
後廢， 長安二年，又分閩縣置 隋縣。
Later abolished. In Chang'an 2, it was again created from Min County. Sui county.
135
後省， 武德六年，分閩縣置新寧縣。其年，改為長樂 聖曆二年，分長樂置萬安縣。天寶元年，改為福唐 武德六年，分閩縣置溫麻縣。其年，改為連江 武德六年置，其年併入連江。長安二年，分連江復置 開元二十九年，開山洞置 永泰年分置 新置。 泉州中，隋建安郡，又為泉州。
Later abolished. In the sixth year of Wude, Xinning County was established by splitting Min County. That same year it was renamed Changle. In the second year of Shengli, Wan'an County was established by splitting Changle. In the first year of Tianbao, it was renamed Futang. In the sixth year of Wude, Wenma County was established by splitting Min County. That same year it was renamed Lianjiang. It was established in the sixth year of Wude and merged into Lianjiang that same year. In the second year of Chang'an, it was re-established by splitting Lianjiang. In the twenty-ninth year of Kaiyuan, mountain settlements were opened and the county was established. It was established by division in the Yongtai era. Newly established. Quan Prefecture, middle grade: under the Sui this was Jian'an Commandery, also called Quan Prefecture.
141
舊治閩縣，後移于南安縣， 聖曆二年，分泉州之南安、莆田、龍溪三縣，置武榮州。 三年，州廢，三縣還泉州， 久視元年，又以三縣置武榮州。景雲二年，改為泉州。開元二十九年，割龍溪屬漳州。天寶元年，改泉州為清源郡。乾元元年，復為泉州。 天寶領縣四，戶二萬三千八百六，口十六萬二百九十五。 在京師東南六千二百一十六里，至東都五千四百一十三里，
Former seat Min; later Nan'an. In the second year of Shengli, Wude 4: Nan'an, Putian, Longxi from Quan; Wurong. Third year: prefecture abolished; three counties to Quan. In Jiushi 1, three counties were again used to create Wurong Prefecture. It became Quan Prefecture in Jingyun 2. In Kaiyuan 29, Longxi was assigned to Zhang Prefecture. In Tianbao 1 Quan became Qingyuan Commandery, and in Qianyuan 1 it returned to Quan Prefecture. Tianbao: four counties, 23,806 households, 160,295 mouths. 6,216 li southeast of the capital, 5,413 li from Luoyang.
142
開元八年，分南安置，今為州之治所 隋縣。武德五年，置豐州，領南安、莆田二縣。貞觀元年，廢豐州，縣屬泉州。聖曆二年，屬武榮州。州廢來屬 武德五年，分南安縣置，屬豐州。
In Kaiyuan 8, it was created from Nan'an and now serves as the prefectural seat. A Sui county. In Wude 5, Feng Prefecture was created with Nan'an and Putian. In Zhenguan 1, Feng was abolished and the county went to Quan Prefecture. In Shengli 2 it belonged to Wurong, and after Wurong was abolished it came here. In Wude 5, it was created from Nan'an County under Feng Prefecture.
143
州廢來屬，
When Wurong abolished, assigned here.
144
聖曆二年，分莆田置清源縣。天寶元年，改為仙遊。 建州中，隋建安郡之建安縣。武德四年，置建州，領綏城、唐興、建陽、沙、將樂、邵武等縣。天寶元年，改為建安郡。乾元元年，復為建州。
In Shengli 2, Qingyuan County was created from Putian. In Tianbao 1, it was renamed Xianyou. Jian Prefecture, middle grade: Sui Jian'an County in Jian'an Commandery. In Wude 4, Jian Prefecture was created with Suicheng, Tangxing, Jianyang, Sha, Jiangle, Shaowu, and other counties. In Tianbao 1 it became Jian'an Commandery, and in Qianyuan 1 it returned to Jian Prefecture.
145
舊領縣二，戶一萬五千三百三十六，口二萬二千八百二十。 天寶領縣六，戶二萬七千二百七十，口一十四萬三千七百七十四。 在京師東南四千九百三十五里，至東都三千八百八十八里。
Formerly two counties, 15,336 households, 22,820 mouths. Tianbao: six counties, 27,270 households, 143,774 mouths. 4,935 li southeast of the capital, 3,888 li from Luoyang.
146
漢冶縣地。吳置建安縣，州所治，以建溪為名 隋縣 載初元年，分建安縣置唐興縣。天授二年，改為武寧。神龍元年，復為唐興。天寶元年，改為浦城 隋廢縣。垂拱四年，分建安置 隋廢縣。垂拱四年五月，分邵武復置 隋廢縣。永徽六年，分建安置。 汀州下，開元二十四年，開福、撫二州山洞，置汀州。天寶元年，改為臨汀郡。乾元元年，復為汀州。
Jian'an: Han Ye territory. Wu established Jian'an; prefectural seat; named for Jian Creek. Sui county. In the first year of Zaichu, Tangxing County was established by splitting Jian'an County. In the second year of Tianshou, it was renamed Wuning. In the first year of Shenlong, it was restored as Tangxing. In the first year of Tianbao, it was renamed Pucheng. A county abolished under the Sui. In the fourth year of Chuigong, it was established by splitting Jian'an. A county abolished under the Sui. In the fifth month of the fourth year of Chuigong, it was re-established by splitting Shaowu. A county abolished under the Sui. In the sixth year of Yonghui, it was established by splitting Jian'an. Ting Prefecture, lower grade: in the twenty-fourth year of Kaiyuan, mountain settlements in Fu and Fu prefectures were opened and Ting Prefecture was established. In the first year of Tianbao, it was renamed Linting Commandery. In the first year of Qianyuan, it again became Ting Prefecture.
151
天寶領縣三，戶四千六百八十，口一萬三千七百二。 在京師東南六千一百七十三里，至東都五千三百七十里。
Tianbao: three counties, 4,680 households, 13,702 mouths. 6,173 li southeast of the capital, 5,370 li from Luoyang.
152
州治所。龍岩寧化已上三縣，並開元二十四年開山洞置。 垂拱二年十二月九日置。天寶元年，改為漳浦郡。 舊屬嶺南道，天寶割屬江南東道， 乾元元年，復為漳州。 天寶領縣二，戶五千三百四十六，口一萬七千九百四十。 在京師東南七千三百里，至東都六千五百里。
Changting: prefectural seat. Longyan and Ninghua — all three by opening caves. It was established on the ninth day of the twelfth month of Chuigong 2. In Tianbao 1, it became Zhangpu Commandery. Formerly Lingnan; Tianbao: Eastern Jiangnan. In Qianyuan 1, it returned to Zhang Prefecture. Tianbao: two counties, 5,346 households, 17,940 mouths. 7,300 li southeast of the capital, 6,500 li from Luoyang.
153
垂拱二年十二月，與州同置。州所治 舊屬泉州。聖曆二年，屬武榮州。景雲二年，還泉州。開元二十九年，屬漳州。 隋宣城郡。武德三年，杜伏威歸化。
Twelfth month: established with the prefecture. Zhangpu: prefectural seat. Formerly under Quan Prefecture, it was assigned to Wurong in Shengli 2, returned to Quan in Jingyun 2, and was assigned to Zhang in Kaiyuan 29. Xuan Prefecture, Western Jiangnan Circuit: Sui Xuancheng Commandery. In Wude 3, Du Fuwei submitted.
154
置宣州總管府。 分宣城置懷安、甯國二縣。 六年，陷輔公祏。 七年賊平，改置宣州都督，督宣、潛、猷、池四州，廢桃州，以綏安來屬，省懷安、甯國二縣。 宣州領宣城、綏安二縣。 八年，廢南豫州，以當塗來屬，廢猷州，以涇縣來屬。 九年，移揚州于江都，以溧陽、溧水、丹陽來屬， 貞觀元年，罷都督府。 廢池州，以秋浦、南陵二縣來屬。 省丹陽入當塗縣。 開元中，析置青陽、太平、甯國三縣，天寶元年，改為宣城郡。至德二年，又析置至德縣。乾元元年，復為宣州。永泰元年，割秋浦、青陽、至德三縣置池州。 舊領縣八，戶二萬二千五百三十七，口九萬五千七百五十三。 天寶領縣九，戶一十二萬一千二百四，口八十八萬四千九百八十五。 今縣十。 在京師東南三千五百五十一里，至東都二千五百一十里。
Xuan protectorate established. Huai'an and Ningguo split from Xuancheng. Wude 6: Fu Gongshi. Wude 7: rebels pacified; Xuan protectorate-general over four prefectures; Tao abolished; Suian here; Huai'an and Ningguo abolished. Xuan governed Xuancheng and Suian. Wude 8: Southern Yu abolished, Dangtu here; You abolished, Jing here. Wude 9: Yang to Jiangdu; Liyang, Lishui, Danyang here. Zhenguan 1: protectorate abolished. Chi abolished; Qiupu and Nanling here. Danyang abolished into Dangtu. During Kaiyuan, Qingyang, Taiping, and Ningguo were created, and in Tianbao 1 it became Xuancheng Commandery. In Zhide 2, Zhide County was added. In Qianyuan 1 it returned to Xuan Prefecture. In Yongtai 1, Qiupu, Qingyang, and Zhide were detached to form Chi Prefecture. Formerly eight counties, 22,537 households, 95,753 mouths. Tianbao: nine counties, 121,204 households, 884,985 mouths. Now ten counties. 3,551 li southeast of the capital, 2,510 li from Luoyang.
155
漢宛陵縣，屬丹陽郡。 秦屬鄣郡。 梁置南豫州，隋改為宣州，煬帝又為宣城郡，皆此治所
Xuancheng: Han Wanling, Danyang commandery. Qin: Zhang commandery. Liang Southern Yu; Sui Xuan; Yang Xuancheng commandery; all at this seat.
156
漢丹陽縣地，屬丹陽郡。 晉分丹陽置於湖縣。 成帝以江北當塗縣流人寓居於湖，乃改為當塗縣，屬宣州。 牛渚山，一名採石，在縣北四十五里大江中， 武德三年，置南豫州，以縣屬。八年，省南豫州，縣屬宣州 漢涇縣，屬丹陽郡。武德三年，置猷州，領涇、南陽、安吳三縣。
Dangtu: Han Danyang, Danyang commandery. Jin split Danyang for Yuhu. Cheng: north-of-river Dangtu migrants at Yuhu; Dangtu County, Xuan. Niuzhu, also Caishi, 45 li north in the great river. In Wude 3, Southern Yu Prefecture was created and the county was assigned to it. In Wude 8, Southern Yu was abolished and the county went to Xuan Prefecture. Jing was Han Jing County under Danyang Commandery. In Wude 3, You Prefecture was created with Jing, Nanyang, and Anwu.
157
八年，廢猷州及南陽、安吳二縣。 屬宣州。 縣界有陵陽山
Wude 8: You abolished; Nanyang and Anwu abolished. Subordinate to Xuan. Lingyang Mountain within the county.
158
漢故鄣縣，屬丹陽郡。 宋分宣城之廣德、吳興之故鄣，置綏安縣。 至德二年九月，改為廣德，以縣界廣德故城為名 漢縣，屬丹陽郡。上元元年十一月，割屬昇州。州廢來屬 漢溧陽地。
Guangde: Han Guzhang, Danyang commandery. Song: Guangde of Xuancheng and Wuxing Guzhang; Suian. In the ninth month of Zhide 2, it was renamed Guangde after the old Guangde city within its borders. Jurong was a Han county under Danyang Commandery. In the eleventh month of Shangyuan 1 it was assigned to Sheng Prefecture, and when Sheng was abolished it came here. Liyang: Han Liyang territory.
160
隋為縣， 武德三年，屬揚州。 九年，屬宣州， 乾元元年，屬昇州。州廢還屬 漢春穀縣地，屬丹陽郡。
Sui: county. In Wude 3, it belonged to Yang Prefecture. Wude 9: Xuan. When Sheng was established, subordinate to Sheng. When Sheng abolished, returned here. Nanling: Han Chungu, Danyang commandery.
161
梁置南陵縣， 武德七年，屬池州。 州廢來屬。 舊治赭圻城，長安四年，移理青陽城 天寶十一載正月，析涇縣置 隋縣。武德六年廢，天寶三載復置 寶應二年二月，析太平縣置。 池州下，隋宣城郡之秋浦縣。武德四年，置池州，領秋浦、南陵二縣。貞觀元年，廢池州，以秋浦屬宣州。永泰元年，江西觀察使李勉以秋浦去洪州九百里，請復置池州，仍請割青陽、至德二縣隸之，又析置石埭縣，並從之。
Liang established Nanling. In Wude 7, it belonged to Chi Prefecture. When Wurong abolished, assigned here. Its old seat was at Zheqi City. In the fourth year of Chang'an, the seat was moved to Qingyang City. In the first month of the eleventh year of Tianbao, it was established by splitting Jing County. A Sui county. It was abolished in the sixth year of Wude and re-established in the third year of Tianbao. In the second month of the second year of Baoying, it was established by splitting Taiping County. Chi Prefecture, lower rank: under the Sui this was Qiupu County of Xuancheng Commandery. In the fourth year of Wude, Chi Prefecture was established, governing Qiupu and Nanling counties. In the first year of Zhenguan, Chi Prefecture was abolished and Qiupu was placed under Xuan Prefecture. In the first year of Yongtai, Li Mian, surveillance commissioner of Jiangxi, said that Qiupu was nine hundred li from Hong Prefecture and requested that Chi Prefecture be restored; he also requested that Qingyang and Zhide counties be detached to it and that Shidai County be established by division. All were approved.
164
後隸宣州。 領縣四，戶一萬九千，口八萬七千九百六十七。
Later subordinate to Xuan. Four counties, 19,000 households, 87,967 mouths.
165
州所治。 漢石城縣，屬丹陽郡。 隋分南陵置秋浦縣，因水為名 天寶元年，分涇、南陵、秋浦三縣置，治古臨城 至德二年析置 永泰二年，割秋浦、浮梁、黟三縣置，治古石埭城。 饒州下，隋鄱陽郡。武德四年，平江左，置饒州，領鄱陽、新平、廣晉、餘幹、樂平、長城、玉亭、弋陽、上饒九縣。
Zhangpu: prefectural seat. Qiupu: Han Shicheng, Danyang commandery. Sui split Nanling for Qiupu, named for the river. Tianbao 1: from Jing, Nanling, Qiupu; seat at ancient Lincheng. It was created in Zhide 2. Tianbao 3: from Qiupu, Fuliang, Yi; ancient Shiling city. Rao Prefecture, lower grade: Sui Poyang commandery. Wude 4: Jiangzuo pacified; Rao with nine counties.
168
七年，省上饒入弋陽，省玉亭入長城、餘幹二縣。 八年，又並長城入餘幹，並新平、廣晉入鄱陽。 舊領縣四，戶一萬一千四百，口五萬九千八百一十七。 天寶，戶四萬八百九十九，口二十四萬四千三百五十。 在京師東南三千二百六十三里，至東都二千四百一十三里。
Wude 7: Shangrao into Yiyang; Yuting into Changcheng and Yugan. Wude 8: Changcheng into Yugan; Xinping and Guangjin into Poyang. Formerly four counties, 11,400 households, 59,817 mouths. Tianbao: 40,899 households, 244,350 mouths. 3,263 li southeast of the capital, 2,413 li from Luoyang.
169
漢縣，屬豫章郡。 古城在今縣東界，有鄱江，今為州所理
Poyang: Han county, Yuzhang commandery. Old city on east border; Po River; now prefectural seat.
170
漢餘幹縣屬豫章郡。 古所謂汗越也。 汗音幹，隋朝去「水」。 樂平武德中置，九年省，後重置 武德中，廢新平縣。開元四年，分鄱陽置，後改新昌。天寶元年復置。 洪州上，都督府，隋豫章郡。武德五年，平林士弘，置洪州總管府，管洪、饒、撫、吉、虔、南平六州，分豫章置鐘陵縣。
Yugan: Han Yugan, Yuzhang commandery. Ancient Gan Yue. Han was pronounced gan; under the Sui the character "水" was dropped. Wude: Leping; Wude 9 abolished; later restored. Xinping County was abolished during Wude. In Kaiyuan 4, it was created from Poyang and later renamed Xinchang. In Tianbao 1 it was restored. Hong Prefecture, upper grade, protectorate: Sui Yuzhang commandery. Wude 4: Lin Shihong pacified; Hong protectorate over six prefectures; Zhongling from Yuzhang.
171
洪州領豫章、豐城、鐘陵三縣。 八年，廢孫州、南昌州、米州，以南昌、建昌、高安三縣來屬。 省鐘陵、南昌二縣入豫章， 貞觀二年，加洪、饒、撫、吉、虔、袁、江、鄂等八州。顯慶四年，督饒、鄂等州。洪州舊領縣四，永淳二年，置新吳縣。長安四年，置武寧縣，又督洪、袁、吉、虔、撫五州。天寶元年，改為豫章郡。乾元元年，復為洪州。 舊領縣四：豫章、豐城、高安、建昌。 戶一萬五千四百五十六，口七萬四千四十四。 天寶領縣六，戶五萬五千五百三十，口三十五萬三千二百三十一。 在京師東南三千九十里，至東都二千二百一十一里。
Hong governed Yuzhang, Fengcheng, Zhongling. Wude 8: Sun, Nanchang, Mi abolished; three counties here. Zhongling and Nanchang into Yuzhang. In Zhenguan 2, eight prefectures were added: Hong, Rao, Fu, Ji, Qian, Yuan, Jiang, and E. In Xianqing 4, it supervised Rao, E, and others. Hong formerly had four counties; Xinwu was created in Yongchun 2. In Chang'an 4, Wuning was created and the command again supervised Hong, Yuan, Ji, Qian, and Fu. In Tianbao 1 it became Yuzhang Commandery, and in Qianyuan 1 it returned to Hong Prefecture. Formerly Yuzhang, Fengcheng, Gao'an, Jianchang. 15,456 households, 74,044 mouths. Tianbao: six counties, 55,530 households, 353,231 mouths. 3,090 li southeast of the capital, 2,211 li from Luoyang.
172
漢南昌縣，豫章郡所治也。 隋改為豫章縣，置洪州，煬帝復為豫章郡。 寶應元年六月，以犯代宗諱，改為鐘陵，取地名 吳分南昌縣置富城縣，晉改為豐城 漢建城縣，屬豫章郡。武德五年，改為高安，仍置靖州，領高安、望蔡、華陽三縣。
Yuzhang: Han Nanchang, Yuzhang commandery seat. Sui Yuzhang County and Hong; Yang Yuzhang commandery. Sixth month: Zhongling, avoiding Daizong taboo. Wu split Nanchang for Fucheng; Jin Fengcheng. Gao'an: Han Jiancheng, Yuzhang commandery. Wude 4: Gao'an; Jing with three counties.
174
七年，改靖州為米州。 其年，又改為筠州。 八年，廢筠州，省華陽、望蔡二縣，以高安屬洪州
Wude 7: Jing to Mi. Same year: Yun Prefecture. Wude 8: Yun abolished; two counties abolished; Gao'an to Hong.
175
漢海昏縣，屬豫章郡。 後漢分立建昌， 武德五年，分置南昌州總管府，管南昌、西吳、靖、米、孫五州。 南昌州領建昌、龍安、永修三縣。 七年，罷都督為南昌州。 八年，廢南昌州及孫州，以南昌州新吳、永修、龍安入建昌縣，以孫州之建昌入豫章縣，而以建昌屬洪州 舊廢縣。永淳二年，分建昌置 長安四年，分建昌置武寧縣。景雲元年，改為豫寧。寶應元年，復為武寧 貞元十六年二月置。 虔州中，隋南康郡。武德五年，平江左，置虔州。天寶元年，改為南康郡。乾元元年，復為虔州。
Jianchang: Han Haihun, Yuzhang commandery. Later Han split Jianchang. In the fifth year of Wude, Wude 4: Nanchangzhou protectorate over five prefectures. Nanchangzhou: Jianchang, Long'an, Yongxiu. Wude 7: protectorate to Nanchang Prefecture. In the eighth year of Wude, Nanchang Prefecture and Sun Prefecture were abolished; Xinwu, Yongxiu, and Long'an of Nanchang Prefecture were merged into Jianchang County, Jianchang of Sun Prefecture was merged into Yuzhang County, and Jianchang was placed under Hong Prefecture. An old abolished county. In the second year of Yongchun, it was established by splitting Jianchang. In the fourth year of Chang'an, Wuning County was established by splitting Jianchang. In the first year of Jingyun, it was renamed Yuning. In the first year of Baoying, it was restored as Wuning. It was established in the second month of the sixteenth year of Zhenyuan. Qian Prefecture, middle grade: under the Sui this was Nankang Commandery. In the fifth year of Wude, after Jiangzuo was pacified, Qian Prefecture was established. In the first year of Tianbao, it was renamed Nankang Commandery. In the first year of Qianyuan, it again became Qian Prefecture.
178
舊領縣四，戶八千九百九十四，口三萬九千九百一。 天寶領縣六，戶三萬七千六百四十七，口二十七萬五千四百一十。 今縣七。 在京師東南四千一十七里，至東都三千四百里。
Formerly four counties, 8,994 households, 39,901 mouths. Tianbao: six counties, 37,647 households, 275,410 mouths. Now seven counties. 4,017 li southeast of the capital, 3,400 li from Luoyang.
179
古濫反州所理，漢縣，屬豫章郡。 漢分豫章立廬陵郡，晉改為南康郡。 隋初為虔州，煬帝為南康郡。 皆治贛 吳分贛立陽都縣，晉改為寧都。隋平陳，改為虔化，屬虔州 漢南縣，屬豫章郡。吳分南埜立南安縣，晉改為南康 漢縣，屬豫章郡 永淳元年，分南康置南安縣。天寶元年，改為信豐 神龍元年，分南康置 貞元四年八月四日置。 撫州中，隋臨川郡。武德五年，討平林士弘，置撫州，領臨川、南城、郡武、宜黃、崇仁、永城、東興、將樂八縣。
Gan: prefectural seat; Han county, Yuzhang. Han split Yuzhang for Luling; Jin Nankang commandery. Early Sui Qian; Yang Nankang commandery. All administered from Gan. Wu split Gan for Yangdu; Jin Ningdu. Sui pacified Chen: Qianhua; Qian. Nankang: Han Nan, Yuzhang commandery. Wu split Nanye for Nan'an; Jin Nankang. Poyang: Han county, Yuzhang commandery. In Yongchun 1, Nan'an County was created from Nankang. In Tianbao 1, it was renamed Xinfeng. Tianbao 2: split from Nankang. Eighth month, day 4: established. Fu Prefecture, middle grade: Sui Linchuan commandery. Wude 4: Lin Shihong suppressed; Fu with eight counties.
185
七年，省東興、永城、將樂三縣，以邵武隸建州。 八年，省宜黃縣， 天寶元年，改為臨川郡。乾元元年，復為撫州。 舊領縣三，戶七千三百五十四，口四萬六百八十五。 天寶領縣四，戶三萬六百五，口十七萬六千三百九十四。 在京師東南三千三百一十二里，至東都二千五百四十里。
Wude 7: three counties abolished; Shaowu to Jian. Wude 8: Yihuang abolished. In Tianbao 1 it became Linchuan Commandery. In Qianyuan 1 it returned to Fu Prefecture. Formerly three counties, 7,354 households, 40,685 mouths. Tianbao: four counties, 30,605 households, 176,394 mouths. 3,312 li southeast of the capital, 2,540 li from Luoyang.
186
州所理。 漢南昌縣地。 後漢分南昌置臨汝縣。 吳置臨川郡，曆南朝不改。 隋平陳，改臨川郡為撫州，仍改臨汝縣為臨川縣。 州郡所理，皆此縣 漢縣，屬豫章郡。開元八年，分南城置 吳分臨汝置新建縣。
Linchuan: prefectural seat. Linchuan: Han Nanchang territory. Later Han split Nanchang for Linru. Wu Linchuan commandery; Southern dynasties unchanged. Sui pacified Chen: Linchuan commandery to Fu; Linru to Linchuan. Prefecture and commandery seats at this county. Poyang was a Han county under Yuzhang Commandery. In Kaiyuan 8, it was created from Nancheng. Wu split Linru for Xinjian.
188
梁改為巴山縣，仍僑置巴山郡。 隋平陳，改巴山為崇仁縣 開元八年，分南城置。 吉州上，隋廬陵郡。武德五年，討平林士弘，置吉州，領廬陵、新淦二縣。
Liang Bashan County; refugee Bashan commandery. Sui pacified Chen: Bashan to Chongren. In Kaiyuan 8, it was created from Nancheng. Ji Prefecture, upper grade: Sui Luling commandery. Wude 4: Lin Shihong suppressed; Ji with Luling and Xingan.
189
七年，廢潁州，以安福縣來屬。 八年，廢南平州，乙太和縣來屬， 天寶元年，改為廬陵郡。乾元元年，復為吉州。 舊領縣四，戶一萬五千四十，口五萬三千二百八十五。 天寶領縣五，戶三萬七千七百五十二，口二十三萬七千三十二。
Wude 7: Ying abolished; Anfu here. Wude 8: Nanping abolished; Yihe here. In Tianbao 1 it became Luling Commandery. In Qianyuan 1 it returned to Ji Prefecture. Formerly four counties, 15,040 households, 53,285 mouths. Tianbao: five counties, 37,752 households, 237,032 mouths.
190
漢縣，屬豫章郡。 後漢改為西昌。 隋復為廬陵，州所治也。 舊治子陽城，永淳元年，移於今所 隋縣。武德五年，置南平州，領太和、永新、廣興、東昌四縣。八年，廢南平州，以永新等三縣並太和，屬吉州 吳置安成郡於此。隋廢為安復，後改為安福 漢舊縣，屬豫章郡。
Poyang: Han county, Yuzhang commandery. Later Han: Xichang. Sui Luling again; prefectural seat. Former seat Ziyang; Wude 4 moved to present site. Sui county. Wude 4: Nanping with four counties. Wude 8: Nanping abolished; three counties with Taihe to Ji. Wu Ancheng commandery here. Sui to Anfu; later Anfu. Xingan: old Han county, Yuzhang.
193
淦，音紺，又音甘。
Gan pronounced gan; also gan.
194
廢縣。顯慶二年，分太和置。 分太和置。江州中，隋九江郡。武德四年，平林士弘，置江州，領湓城、潯陽、彭澤三縣。 五年，置總管，管江、鄂、智、浩四州，並管昌、洪四總管府。 又分湓城置楚城縣，分彭澤置都昌縣。 八年，廢浩州及樂城縣入彭澤縣，又廢湓城入潯陽， 貞觀元年，罷都督府。 八年，廢楚城縣入潯陽， 天寶元年，改為潯陽郡。乾元元年，復為江州。 舊領縣三，戶六千三百六十，口二萬五千五百九十九。 天寶，戶二萬九千二十五，口十五萬五千七百四十四。 在京師東南二千九百四十八里，至東都二千一百九十七里。
County abolished. Tianbao 2: split from Taihe. Jiang Prefecture, middle grade: Sui Jiujiang commandery. Wude 4: Lin Shihong pacified; Jiang with three counties. Wude 5: protectorate over four prefectures and two protectorate offices. Chucheng from Tuncheng; Duchang from Pengze. Wude 8: Hao abolished; Lecheng into Pengze; Tuncheng into Xunyang. Zhenguan 1: protectorate abolished. Zhenguan 8: Chucheng into Xunyang. In Tianbao 1 it became Xunyang Commandery. In Qianyuan 1 it returned to Jiang Prefecture. Formerly three counties, 6,360 households, 25,599 mouths. Tianbao: 29,025 households, 155,744 mouths. 2,948 li southeast of the capital, 2,197 li from Luoyang.
195
州所理。 漢縣，屬廬江郡。 晉置江州。 隋改為彭蠡縣，取州東南五十二里有彭蠡湖為名。 煬帝改為湓城，取縣界湓水為名， 武德四年，復為潯陽，潯水至此入江為名 武德五年，分彭澤置，屬浩州。八年，廢浩州，縣屬江州 漢縣，屬豫章郡。
Linchuan: prefectural seat. Xunyang: Han county, Lujiang commandery. Jin: Jiang Prefecture. Sui Pengli County, from Lake Pengli 52 li southeast. Yang Tuncheng, from Tun River in bounds. Wude 4: Xunyang again; Xun River enters Yangtze here. Wude 5: split from Pengze; Hao. Wude 8: Hao abolished; county to Jiang. Poyang: Han county, Yuzhang commandery.
197
隋為龍城縣， 武德五年，置浩州，又分置都昌、樂城二縣。 八年，罷浩州，以彭澤屬江州，仍省樂城入彭澤。 至德二年九月，中丞宋若思奏置。 袁州下，隋宜春郡。武德四年，平蕭銑，置袁州。天寶元年，改為宜春郡。乾元元年，復為袁州。 舊領縣三，戶四千六百三十六，口二萬五千七百一十六。 天寶，戶二萬七千九十一，口一十四萬四千九十六。 在京師東南三千五百八十里，至東都二千一百六十一里。
Sui: Longcheng County. Wude 5: Hao; Duchang and Lecheng split. Wude 8: Hao abolished; Pengze to Jiang; Lecheng into Pengze. Ninth month: censor Song Ruosi memorialized; established. Yuan Prefecture, lower grade: Sui Yichun Commandery. In Wude 4, after Xiao Xian was pacified, Yuan Prefecture was created. In Tianbao 1 it became Yichun Commandery, and in Qianyuan 1 it returned to Yuan Prefecture. Formerly three counties, 4,636 households, 25,716 mouths. Tianbao: 27,091 households, 144,096 mouths. 3,580 li southeast of the capital, 2,161 li from Luoyang.
198
州所理。 漢縣，屬豫章郡。 吳為安成郡，南朝不改。 晉改為宜陽。 隋置袁州，煬帝為宜春郡。 復改為宜春。 宜春，泉水名，在州西。 取此水為酒，作貢。
Linchuan: prefectural seat. Poyang: Han county, Yuzhang commandery. Wu Ancheng commandery; Southern dynasties unchanged. Jin: Yiyang. Sui Yuan; Yang Yichun commandery. Again Yichun. Yichun spring west of the prefecture. Wine from this water sent as tribute.
199
吳分宜春置萍鄉縣，屬安成郡。 吳分宜春置新喻，屬安成郡。 鄂州上，隋江夏郡。武德四年，平蕭銑，改為鄂州。天寶元年，改為江夏郡。乾元元年，復為鄂州。
Wu split Yichun for Pingxiang, Ancheng commandery. Wu split Yichun for Xinyu, Ancheng commandery. E Prefecture, upper grade: Sui Jiangxia Commandery. In Wude 4, after Xiao Xian was pacified, it became E Prefecture. In Tianbao 1 it became Jiangxia Commandery, and in Qianyuan 1 it returned to E Prefecture.
200
永泰後，置鄂嶽觀察使，領鄂、嶽、蘄、黃四州，恆以鄂州為使理所。 舊領縣四，戶三千七百五十四，口一萬四千六百一十五。 天寶領縣五，戶一萬九千一百九十，口八萬四千五百六十三。 後並沔州入鄂州，以漢陽、𣿭川來屬。 在京師東南二千三百四十六里，至東都一千五百三十里。
After Yongtai: E-Yue commissioner over E, Yue, Qi, Huang; seat at E. Formerly four counties, 3,754 households, 14,615 mouths. Tianbao: five counties, 19,190 households, 84,563 mouths. Later Mian merged into E; Hanyang and Mianchuan here. 2,346 li southeast of the capital, 1,530 li from Luoyang.
201
漢郡名。 本漢沙羨縣地，屬江夏郡。 晉改沙羨為沙陽。 江、漢二水會於州西，春秋謂之夏汭，晉、宋謂之夏口。 宋置江夏郡。 治於此。 隋不改， 武德四年，改為鄂州，取漢縣名 漢鄂縣地，屬江夏郡。吳分鄂置新陽縣，隋改為永興 漢鄂縣，屬江夏郡。吳、晉為重鎮，以名將為鎮守 吳分沙羨縣置 天寶二年，開山洞置 漢安陸縣地，屬江夏郡。
Lujiang was the name of a Han commandery. Originally Han Shaxian, Jiangxia commandery. Jin: Shaxian to Shayang. Jiang and Han meet west; Spring and Autumn Xiarui; Jin and Song Xiakou. Song: Jiangxia commandery. Administered here. Sui unchanged. Wude 4: E Prefecture, from Han county name. E County territory, Jiangxia commandery. Wu split E for Xinyang; Sui Yongxing. Han E County, Jiangxia commandery. Wu and Jin major stronghold; famous generals as garrison commanders. Wu split Shaxian to establish. Tianbao 2: opened mountain caves and established. Hanyang: Han Anlu territory, Jiangxia commandery.
206
晉置沌陽縣。 隋初為漢津縣，煬帝改為漢陽， 武德四年，平硃粲，分沔陽郡置沔州，治漢陽縣。 貞觀，戶一千五百一十七，口六千九百五十九。 至太和七年，鄂岳節度使牛僧孺奏，沔州與鄂州隔江，都管一縣，請併入鄂州，從之。 舊屬淮南道。
Jin: Zhunyang County. Early Sui Hanjin; Yang Hanyang. Wude 4: Zhu Can pacified; Mian from Mianyang commandery at Hanyang. Zhenguan: 1,517 households, 6,959 mouths. Yongtai: Niu Sengru; Mian across river from E, one county; merged into E; granted. Formerly Huainan Circuit.
207
漢安陸縣地，後魏置𣿭川郡， 武德四年，分漢陽縣置𣿭川縣，屬沔州。 州廢，屬鄂州。 岳州下，隋巴陵郡。武德四年，平蕭銑，置巴州，領巴陵、華容、沅江、羅、湘陰五縣。 六年，改為岳州。 省羅縣， 天寶元年，改為巴陵郡。 乾元元年，復為岳州。 舊領縣四，戶四千二，口一萬七千五百五十六。 天寶領縣五，戶一萬一千七百四十，口五萬二百九十八。 在京師東南二千二百三十七里，至東都一千八百一十六里。
Mianchuan: Han Anlu; Northern Wei Mianchuan commandery. Wude 4: Mianchuan from Hanyang; Mian. When Mian abolished, assigned to E. Yue Prefecture, lower grade: Sui Baling commandery. Wude 4: Xiao Xian pacified; Ba with five counties. Wude 6: Yue Prefecture. Luo County abolished. In the first year of Tianbao, it was renamed Baling Commandery. In the first year of Qianyuan, it was restored as Yue Prefecture. Formerly four counties, 4,002 households, 17,556 mouths. Tianbao: five counties, 11,740 households, 50,298 mouths. 2,237 li southeast of the capital, 1,816 li from Luoyang.
208
漢下雋縣，屬長沙郡。 吳置巴陵縣。 晉置建昌郡，隋改為巴州，煬帝改為巴陵郡。 武德置岳州，皆置巴陵縣。 縣界有古巴丘
Baling: Han Xiajun, Changsha commandery. Wu established Baling. Jin Jianchang commandery; Sui Ba Prefecture; Yang Baling commandery. Wude: Yue established; Baling always established. Ancient Baqiu within the county.
209
漢孱陵縣地，屬武陵郡，劉表改為安南。 隋改為華容， 垂拱二年，去「華」字，曰容城。神龍元年，復為華容 漢益陽縣，屬長沙國。隋改為安樂，又改為沅江，屬岳州 漢羅縣，屬長沙國。宋置湘陰縣，縣界汨水，注入湘江 神龍三年，分湘陰縣置。 潭州中，都督府，隋長沙郡。武德四年，平蕭銑，置潭州總管府，管潭、衡、永、郴、連、南梁、南雲、南營八州。
Huarong: Han Canling, Wuling; Liu Biao Annan. Sui: Huarong. In the first year of Qianyuan, the character "華" was dropped, and it was called Rongcheng. Baoying 2: Huarong again. Yuanjiang: Han Yiyang, Changsha kingdom. Sui Anle then Yuanjiang; Yue. Luo: Han Luo, Changsha kingdom. Song Xiangyin; Mi River into Xiang within bounds. Tianbao 2: split from Xiangyin. Tan Prefecture, middle protectorate: Sui Changsha commandery. Wude 4: Xiao Xian pacified; Tan protectorate over eight prefectures.
212
潭州領長沙、衡山、醴陵、湘鄉、益陽、新康六縣。 七年，廢雲州，改南梁為邵州，南營為道州。 省新康縣。 督潭、衡、郴、連、永、邵、道等七州， 天寶元年，改為長沙郡。乾元元年，復為潭州。 舊領縣五，戶九千三十一，口四萬四百四十九。 天寶領縣六，戶三萬二千二百七十二，口十九萬二千六百五十七。 在京師南二千四百四十五里，至東都二千一百八十五里。
Tan governed six counties. Wude 7: Yun abolished; Nanliang to Shao; Nanying to Dao. Xinkang abolished. Supervised Tan, Heng, Chen, Lian, Yong, Shao, Dao, and others. In Tianbao 1 it became Changsha Commandery. In Qianyuan 1 it returned to Tan Prefecture. Formerly five counties, 9,031 households, 40,449 mouths. Tianbao: six counties, 32,272 households, 192,657 mouths. 2,445 li south of the capital, 2,185 li from Luoyang.
213
秦置長沙郡。 漢為長沙國，治臨湘縣。 後漢為長沙郡。 吳不改。 晉懷帝置湘州，至梁初不改。 隋平陳，為潭州，以昭潭為名。 煬帝改為長沙郡，仍改臨湘為長沙縣。 武德復為潭州。 湘潭後漢湘南縣地，屬長沙郡。 吳分汀南立衡陽縣，屬衡陽郡。 隋廢郡，縣屬潭州， 天寶八年，移治於洛口，因改為湘潭縣。
Qin: Changsha commandery. Han: Changsha kingdom at Linxiang. Later Han: Changsha commandery. Wu unchanged. Jin Huai: Xiang Prefecture; early Liang unchanged. Sui pacified Chen: Tan, from Lake Zhaotan. Yang Changsha commandery; Linxiang to Changsha County. Wude: Tan Prefecture again. Xiangtan: Later Han Xiangnan, Changsha commandery. Wu split Tingnan for Hengyang, Hengyang commandery. Sui abolished commandery; county to Tan. In Tianbao 8, the seat moved to Luokou, so it was renamed Xiangtan County.
214
漢鐘武縣，屬零陵郡。後漢改為重安，永建三年，又名湘鄉，屬長沙郡。 漢縣，屬長沙國，故城在今縣東八十里。
Xiangxiang: Han Zhongwu, Lingling commandery. Later Han Chong'an, also Xiangxiang, Changsha commandery. Yiyang: Han county, Changsha kingdom; old city 80 li east.
215
武德四年，分置新康縣。 七年，省入。
Wude 4: Xinkang split off. Wude 7: abolished and merged in.
216
漢臨湘縣，界有醴陵，後漢立為縣，屬長沙郡。隋廢，武德四年，分長沙置。 吳分長沙置瀏陽縣，隋廢。景龍二年，於故城復置。 衡州中，隋衡山郡。武德四年，平蕭銑，置衡州，領臨蒸、湘潭、耒陽、新甯、重安、新城六縣。
Liling: within Linxiang; Later Han county, Changsha commandery. Sui abolished; Wude 4 split from Changsha. Wu split Changsha for Liuyang; Sui abolished. Wude 4: re-established at old city. Heng Prefecture, middle grade: Sui Hengshan commandery. Wude 4: Xiao Xian pacified; Heng with six counties.
217
七年，省重安、新城二縣， 貞觀元年，以廢南雲州之攸縣來屬。天寶元年，改為衡陽郡。乾元元年，復為衡州。 舊領縣五，戶七千三百三十，口三萬四千四百八十一。 天寶領縣六，戶三萬三千六百八十八，口十九萬九千二百二十八。 在京師東南三千四百三里，至東都二千七百六十里。
Wude 7: Chong'an and Xincheng abolished. In Zhenguan 1, You County from abolished Nanyun Prefecture was assigned here. In Tianbao 1 it became Hengyang Commandery, and in Qianyuan 1 it returned to Heng Prefecture. Formerly five counties, 7,330 households, 34,481 mouths. Tianbao: six counties, 33,688 households, 199,228 mouths. 3,403 li southeast of the capital, 2,760 li from Luoyang.
218
漢蒸陽縣，屬長沙國。 吳分蒸陽立臨蒸縣，吳末分長沙東界郡立湘東郡。 宋、齊、梁不改。 隋罷湘東郡為衡州，改臨蒸為衡陽縣， 武德四年，復為臨蒸。開元二十年，復為衡陽 吳分耒陽立新寧縣，屬湘東郡。舊治三洞，神龍二年，移治麻州。開元九年，治宜江。天寶元年，改為常寧 漢縣，屬長沙國，縣北有攸溪故也 漢縣，屬長沙國。
Linzheng: Han Zhengyang, Changsha kingdom. Wu split Zhengyang for Linzheng; late Wu eastern Changsha for Xiangdong commandery. Song, Qi, and Liang unchanged. Sui Xiangdong to Heng Prefecture; Linzheng to Hengyang. In Wude 4 it became Linzheng again. In Kaiyuan 20 it again became Hengyang. The Wu created Xinning from Leiyang under Xiangdong Commandery. Its old seat was at Sandong; in Shenlong 2 it moved to Mazhou, in Kaiyuan 9 to Yijiang, and in Tianbao 1 it was renamed Changning. You: Han county, Changsha kingdom; old You Creek north. Chaling: Han county, Changsha kingdom.
221
隋廢， 聖曆元年，分攸縣置 漢縣，屬桂陽郡。
Sui abolished it. Wude 4: split from You. Leiyang: Han county, Guiyang commandery.
222
隋改為耒陰， 武德四年，復為耒陽。
Sui: Leiyin. Wude 4: Leiyang again.
223
吳分湘南縣置。 舊屬潭州，後割屬衡州。 澧州下，隋澧陽郡。武德四年，平蕭銑，置澧州，領孱陵、安鄉、澧陽、石門、慈利、崇義六縣。貞觀元年，省孱陵縣。天寶元年，改為澧陽郡。乾元元年，復為澧州。 天寶初，割屬山南東道。 舊領縣五，戶三千四百七十四，口二萬五千八百二十六。 天寶領縣四，戶一萬九千六百二十，口九萬三千三百四十九。 在京師東南一千八百九十三里，至東都一千五百七十二里。
Wu split Xiangnan to establish. Formerly Tan; later to Heng. Li Prefecture, lower grade: Sui Liyang Commandery. In Wude 4, after Xiao Xian was pacified, Li Prefecture was created with six counties. Canling was abolished in Zhenguan 1. In Tianbao 1 it became Liyang Commandery, and in Qianyuan 1 it returned to Li Prefecture. Early Tianbao: Eastern Shannan Circuit. Formerly five counties, 3,474 households, 25,826 mouths. Tianbao: four counties, 19,620 households, 93,349 mouths. 1,893 li southeast of the capital, 1,572 li from Luoyang.
224
漢零陽縣，屬武陵郡。 吳分武陵西界置天門郡。 晉末，以義陽流人集此，僑置南義陽郡。 隋平陳，改南義陽為澧州。 皆治此縣
Liyang: Han Lingyang, Wuling commandery. Wu split western Wuling for Tianmen commandery. Late Jin Yiyang migrants; refugee Southern Yiyang commandery. Sui pacified Chen: Southern Yiyang to Li Prefecture. The seat was always at this county.
225
漢孱陵縣地，屬武陵郡。 隋分立安鄉縣， 貞觀元年，廢孱陵併入 吳分零陽縣於此置天門郡。隋平陳，廢天門郡，以廢州為石門縣 本漢零陽縣，隋改零陽為慈利縣。麟德元年，省崇義併入。 朗州下，隋武陵郡。武德四年，平蕭銑，置朗州。天寶元年，改為武陵郡。乾元元年，復為朗州。
Anxiang: Han Canling, Wuling commandery. Sui separately established Anxiang. In the first year of Zhenguan, Canling was abolished and merged in. Wu split Lingyang here for Tianmen commandery. Sui pacified Chen: Tianmen abolished; abolished prefecture to Shimen County. Originally Han Lingyang County, under the Sui Lingyang was renamed Cili County. In the first year of Linde, Chongyi was abolished and merged in. Lang Prefecture, lower grade: under the Sui this was Wuling Commandery. In the fourth year of Wude, after Xiao Xian was pacified, Lang Prefecture was established. In the first year of Tianbao, it was renamed Wuling Commandery. In the first year of Qianyuan, it again became Lang Prefecture.
227
天寶初，割屬山南東道，舊領縣二，戶二千一百四十九，口一萬九百一十三。 天寶，戶九千三百六，口四萬三千七百十六。 在京師東南二千一百五十九里，至東都一千八百五十八里。
Early Tianbao: Eastern Shannan; formerly two counties, 2,149 households, 10,913 mouths. Tianbao: 9,306 households, 43,716 mouths. 2,159 li southeast of the capital, 1,858 li from Luoyang.
228
漢臨沅縣地，屬武陵郡。 秦屬黔中郡地。 梁分武陵郡于縣置武州。 陳改武州為沅陵郡。 隋平陳，復為嵩州，尋又改為朗州。 煬帝為武陵郡。 武德復為朗州。 皆治于武陵縣 隋縣，取洲名。 永州中，隋零陵郡。武德四年，平蕭銑，置永州，領零陵、湘源、祁陽、灌陽四縣。
Wuling: Han Linyuan, Wuling commandery. Qin: Qianzhong commandery territory. Liang split Wuling; Wu Prefecture at the county. Chen: Yuanling commandery. Sui pacified Chen: Song Prefecture; soon Lang again. Yang: Wuling commandery. Wude: Lang Prefecture again. All administered from Wuling. Sui county, from prefecture name. Yong Prefecture, middle grade: Sui Lingling commandery. Wude 4: Xiao Xian pacified; Yong with four counties.
229
七年，省灌陽， 貞觀元年，省祁陽縣，四年，復置。天寶元年，改為零陵郡。乾元元年，復為永州。 舊領縣三，戶六千三百四十八，口二萬七千五百八十三。 天寶，戶二萬七千四百九十四，口十七萬六千一百六十八。 在京師南三千二百七十四里，至東都三千六百六十五里。
Wude 7: Guanyang abolished. Qiyang County was abolished in Zhenguan 1 and restored in Zhenguan 4. In Tianbao 1 it became Lingling Commandery, and in Qianyuan 1 it returned to Yong Prefecture. Formerly three counties, 6,348 households, 27,583 mouths. Tianbao: 27,494 households, 176,168 mouths. 3,274 li south of capital, 3,665 li from Luoyang.
230
漢泉陵縣地，屬零陵郡。 漢郡治泉陵縣，故城在今州北二里。 隋平陳，改泉陵為零陵縣，仍移於今理。 梁、陳皆為零陵郡，隋置永州，煬帝復為零陵郡，皆治此縣
Lingling: Han Quanling, Lingling commandery. Han seat Quanling; old city 2 li north of present prefecture. Sui pacified Chen: Quanling to Lingling; seat moved. Liang and Chen Lingling commandery; Sui Yong; Yang Lingling; all at this county.
231
吳分泉陵縣，於今縣東北九十里置祁陽縣，今有古城。 隋平陳，併入零陵， 武德四年，復分置，移於今治。貞觀元年省，四年又置。 石燕岡在祁陽西北一百一十里，此岡穴出石燕，充貢。 湘水南自零陵界來 漢零陵縣地，屬故城在今縣南七十八里。隋平陳，並零陵入湘源縣 漢零陵縣地，大業末，蕭銑析湘源縣置。武德七年廢。上元二年，荊南節度使呂諲奏，復於故城置灌陽縣。
Wu split Quanling for Qiyang 90 li northeast; old city remains. Sui pacified Chen: merged into Lingling. In Wude 4, it was re-created and moved to the present seat. It was abolished in Zhenguan 1 and restored in Zhenguan 4. Shiyan Ridge 110 li northwest of Qiyang; stone swallows from cave as tribute. Xiang River from Lingling border south. Xiangyuan: Han Lingling; old city 78 li south. Sui pacified Chen: Lingling into Xiangyuan. Xiangyuan: Han Lingling; Daye end Xiao Xian split from Xiangyuan. Abolished. Jingnan commissioner Lü Yin: Guanyang restored at old city.
233
灌水在城西，今名灌源。 道州中，隋零陵郡之永陽縣。武德四年，平蕭銑，置營州，領營道、江華、永陽、唐興四縣。 五年，改為南營州， 貞觀八年，改為道州，仍省永陽縣。 十七年廢，併入永州， 上元二年，復析永州置。 天寶元年，改為江華郡。 乾元元年，復為道州。 舊領縣三，戶六千六百一十三，口三萬一千八百八十。 天寶領縣四，戶二萬二千五百五十一，口十三萬九千六十三。 今領縣五。
Guan River west of city; now Guanyuan. Dao Prefecture, middle grade: Sui Yongyang in Lingling commandery. Wude 4: Xiao Xian pacified; Ying with four counties. Wude 5: Southern Ying Prefecture. Zhenguan 8: Dao Prefecture; Yongyang abolished. Seventeenth year abolished into Yong. In Shangyuan year 2, it was again split from Yong Prefecture and established. In the first year of Tianbao, it was renamed Jianghua Commandery. In the first year of Qianyuan, it was restored as Dao Prefecture. Formerly three counties, 6,613 households, 31,880 mouths. Tianbao: four counties, 22,551 households, 139,063 mouths. Now five counties.
234
漢營浦縣，屬零陵郡。 吳置營陽郡。 晉改為永陽郡。 隋平陳，改營浦為永陽縣， 武德四年，于縣置營州，改為營道縣。 五年，又加「南」字， 貞觀八年，改為道州。天寶元年，改營道為弘道 漢泠道縣，屬零陵郡，古城在今縣東界南四十里。
Yingdao: Han Yingpu, Lingling commandery. Wu: Yingyang commandery. Jin: Yongyang commandery. Sui pacified Chen: Yingpu to Yongyang. Wude 4: Ying at county; Yingdao County. In the fifth year of Wude, the character "南" was added. Zhenguan 8: Dao Prefecture. Tianbao 1: Hongdao. Tangxing: Han Lingdao, Lingling; old city 40 li south on east border.
235
隋平陳，廢泠道入營道縣，仍於泠道廢城置營道縣， 武德四年，移營道縣于州郭置，仍于此置唐興縣。長壽二年，改名武盛。神龍元年，復為唐興。天寶元年，改為延唐。泠水，在今縣南六十里 漢馮乘縣，屬蒼梧郡。武德四年，析賀州馮乘縣置江華縣。貞觀十七年，改屬永州。上元二年，還道州。文明元年，改為雲溪縣。神龍元年二月，復為江華 隋改漢營浦縣為永陽，置道州。
Sui pacified Chen: Lingdao into Yingdao; seat at old Lingdao city. In the fourth year of Wude, Yingdao County was moved below the prefectural walls, and Tangxing County was established here. In the second year of Changshou, it was renamed Wusheng. In the first year of Shenlong, it was restored as Tangxing. In the first year of Tianbao, it was renamed Yantang. The Ling River is sixty li south of the present county. Jianghua was Han Fengcheng County, belonging to Cangwu Commandery. In the fourth year of Wude, Jianghua County was established by splitting Fengcheng County of He Prefecture. In the seventeenth year of Zhenguan, it was transferred to Yong Prefecture. In the second year of Shangyuan, it returned to Dao Prefecture. In the first year of Wenming, it was renamed Yunxi County. In the second month of the first year of Shenlong, it was restored as Jianghua. Sui: Han Yingpu to Yongyang; Dao Prefecture.
237
後州郭內置營道縣，乃移永陽之名於州西南一百一十里置。 貞觀八年省，地入營道。天授二年，復析營道置。天寶元年，改為永明縣 大曆二年，湖南觀察使韋貫之奏請析延唐縣，于道州東南二百二十里舂陵侯故城北十五里置縣，因以大曆為名。 郴州中，隋桂陽郡。武德四年，平蕭銑，置郴州，領郴、盧陽、義章、臨武、平陽、晉興六縣。
Later Yingdao in walls; Yongyang name moved 110 li southwest. Abolished in Zhenguan 8, its territory went to Yingdao. In Tianshou 2, it was again created from Yingdao. In Tianbao 1, it was renamed Yongming County. Wei Guanzhi: split Yantang; county 15 li north of Chunling marquis city; named for Dali. Chen Prefecture, middle grade: Sui Guiyang commandery. Wude 4: Xiao Xian pacified; Chen with six counties.
238
七年，廢義章、平陽二縣。 八年，省晉興， 天寶元年，改為桂陽郡。乾元元年，復為郴州。 舊領縣五，戶八千六百四十六，口四萬九千三百五十五。 天寶領縣八，戶三萬一千三百三。 在京師東南三千三百里，至東都三千五十七里。
Wude 7: Yizhang and Pingyang abolished. Wude 8: Jinxing abolished. In Tianbao 1 it became Guiyang Commandery. In Qianyuan 1 it returned to Chen Prefecture. Formerly five counties, 8,646 households, 49,355 mouths. Tianbao: eight counties, 31,303 households. 3,300 li southeast of capital, 3,057 li from Luoyang.
239
漢縣，屬桂陽郡，漢郡理所也。 後漢郡理耒陽，尋還郴。 宋、齊封子弟為桂陽王，皆治於此。 隋平陳，改為郴州，煬帝為桂陽郡，武德四年，改郴州，皆以郴為理。 大業末，蕭銑分郴置。武德七年省，八年復置。長壽元年，分義章南界置高平縣。開元二十三年，廢高平，仍移義章治高平廢縣。 晉分郴縣置汝城、晉寧二縣。
Chen: Han county, Guiyang commandery; Han commandery seat. Later Han seat to Leiyang; soon back to Chen. Song and Qi Guiyang kings administered here. Sui pacified Chen: Chen Prefecture; Yang Guiyang commandery; Chen seat throughout. At the end of Daye, Xiao Xian created it from Chen. It was abolished in Wude 7 and restored in Wude 8. In Changshou 1, Gaoping County was created from southern Yizhang. In Kaiyuan 23, Gaoping was abolished and Yizhang's seat moved to the former Gaoping county. Jin split Chen for Rucheng and Jinning.
241
陳廢二縣，立盧陽郡，領盧陽縣。 開皇九年廢郡，以盧陽屬郴州。天寶元年，改為義昌。 晉分郴置平陽郡及縣。
Chen abolished two counties; Luyang commandery with Luyang. In Kaihuang 9, the commandery was abolished and Luyang assigned to Chen Prefecture. In Tianbao 1, it was renamed Yichang. Jin split Chen for Pingyang commandery and county.
242
陳廢，後蕭銑復分郴置。 武德七年省，八年復置。
Chen abolished; later Xiao Xian split Chen again. In the seventh year of Wude, abolished; eighth year restored.
243
後漢分郴置漢寧縣。 吳改為陽安，晉改為晉甯，隋改為晉興。 貞觀八年省，咸亨三年復置，改名資興。 漢便縣地，屬桂陽郡。
Later Han split Chen for Hanning. Wu Yang'an; Jin Jinning; Sui Jinxing. Abolished in Zhenguan 8, it was restored in Xianheng 3 as Zixing. Linwu: Han Bian, Guiyang commandery.
244
晉省，陳復置。 隋廢， 開元十三年，宇文融析郴縣北界四鄉置安陵縣。天寶元年，改為高亭，取縣東山名。 漢縣，屬桂陽郡，縣南臨武溪故也。 漢南平縣，屬桂陽郡。
Jin abolished; Chen restored. Sui abolished it. Kaiyuan 4: Yu Wenrong split four north districts of Chen for Anling. Tianbao 1: Gaoting, from east county mountain. Linwu: Han county, Guiyang; Linwu Creek south gives name. Nanping: Han Nanping, Guiyang commandery.
246
隋廢， 咸亨二年，復置南平縣。天寶元年，改為藍山。 九疑山，在縣西五十里。 隋長沙郡之邵陽縣。武德四年，平蕭銑，置南梁州，領邵陵、建興、武岡三縣。 七年：省建興入武岡，省邵陵並邵陽， 貞觀十年，改名邵州。天寶元年，改為邵陽郡。乾元元年，復為邵州。 舊領縣二，戶二千八百五十六，口一萬三千五百八十三。 天寶，戶一萬七千七十三，口七萬一千六百四十四。 在京師東南三千四百里，至東都二千二百六十八里。
Sui abolished it. Nanping County was restored in Xianheng 2. In Tianbao 1, it was renamed Lanshan. Mount Jiuyi 50 li west. Shao Prefecture: Sui Shaoyang in Changsha commandery. Wude 4: Xiao Xian pacified; Southern Liang with three counties. Wude 7: Jianxing into Wugang; Shaoling into Shaoyang. It was renamed Shao Prefecture in Zhenguan 10. In Tianbao 1 it became Shaoyang Commandery, and in Qianyuan 1 it returned to Shao Prefecture. Formerly two counties, 2,856 households, 13,583 mouths. Tianbao: 17,073 households, 71,644 mouths. 3,400 li southeast of capital, 2,268 li from Luoyang.
247
漢昭陵縣，屬長沙國。 後漢改為昭陽，晉改為邵陽。 隋平陳，復於今理。 吳分零陵北部置邵陵郡。 隋平陳，廢郡，以邵陽屬潭州，尋又于邵陽置建州， 武德四年，改置南梁州，貞觀十年，改為邵州，皆理邵陽縣。 漢都梁縣，屬零陵郡。
Shaoyang: Han Zhaoling, Changsha kingdom. Later Han Zhaoyang; Jin Shaoyang. Sui pacified Chen: restored at present seat. Wu split northern Lingling for Shaoling commandery. Sui pacified Chen: commandery abolished; Shaoyang to Tan; Jian at Shaoyang. In Wude 4, it became Southern Liang Prefecture, and in Zhenguan 10 it became Shao Prefecture; both used Shaoyang County as their seat. Wugang: Han Duliang, Lingling commandery.
248
晉分都梁置武岡縣。 隋廢， 武德四年，分邵陽復置。 隋熙平郡。武德四年，平蕭銑，置連州。天寶元年，改為連山郡。乾元元年，復為連州。 舊領縣三，戶五千五百六十三，口三萬一千九十四。 天寶，戶三萬二千二百十，口一十四萬三千五百三十二。 在京師南三千六百六十五里，至東都三千四百五里。
Jin split Duliang for Wugang. Sui abolished it. Wude 4: again split from Shaoyang. Lian Prefecture: Sui Xiping Commandery. In Wude 4, after Xiao Xian was pacified, Lian Prefecture was created. In Tianbao 1 it became Lianshan Commandery, and in Qianyuan 1 it returned to Lian Prefecture. Formerly three counties, 5,563 households, 31,094 mouths. Tianbao: 32,210 households, 143,532 mouths. 3,665 li south of capital, 3,405 li from Luoyang.
249
漢縣，屬桂陽郡，今州理是也。隋開皇十年，于縣置連州，大業改為熙平郡，武德四年，復為連州，皆以桂陽為理所。 漢縣，屬桂陽郡。
Guiyang: Han county, Guiyang commandery; present seat here. Sui Lian at county; Daye Xiping commandery; Lian again; all at Guiyang. Leiyang: Han county, Guiyang commandery.
250
後漢省。 晉平吳，分浛洭縣復置。 梁于浛洭縣西置陽山郡，以縣屬之。 隋廢郡，縣屬連州， 神龍元年，移于洭水之北，今縣理是也。 一名湟水。
Later Han abolished it. Jin pacified Wu: Hengqu restored. Liang Yangshan commandery west of Hengqu; county subordinate. Sui abolished commandery; county to Lian. In the first year of Shenlong, Wude 4: moved north of Heng River; present seat. Also called Huang River.

晉武分桂陽立廣惠縣，隋改為廣澤。仁壽元年，改為連山。 黔中道黔州下，都督府，隋黔安郡。武德元年，改為黔州，領彭水、都上、石城三縣。 二年，又分置盈隆、洪杜、相永、萬資四縣。 四年，置都督府，督務、施、業、辰、智、牂、充、應、莊等州。 其年，以相永、萬資二縣置費州，以都上分置夷州。 十年，以思州高富來屬。 十一年，又以高富屬夷州，以智州信寧來屬。 今督思、辰、施、牢、費、夷、巫、應、播、充、莊、牂、琰、池、矩十五州。 其年，罷都督府。 置莊州都督府。 景龍四年廢，以播州為都督。先天二年廢，復以黔州為都督。天寶元年，改黔州為黔中郡，依舊都督施、夷、播、思、費、珍、溱、商九州。 又領充、明、勞、羲、福、犍、邦、琰、清、莊、峨、蠻、牂、鼓、儒、琳、鸞、令、那、暉、郝、總、敦、侯、晃、柯、樊、稜、添、普寧、功、亮、茂龍、延、訓、卿、雙、整、懸、撫水、矩、思源、逸、殷、南平、勳、薑、襲等五十州。 皆羈縻，寄治山谷， 乾元元年，復以黔中郡為黔州都督府。 舊領縣五，戶五千九百一十三，口二萬七千四百三十三。 天寶縣六，戶四千二百七十，口二萬四千二百四。 在京師南三千一百九十三里，至東都三千二百七十一里。
Jin Wu split Guiyang for Guanghui; Sui Guangze. Tianbao 1: Lianshan. Qian Prefecture, lower grade protectorate, Qianzhong Circuit: Sui Qian'an Commandery. In Wude 1, it became Qian Prefecture with Pengshui, Dushang, and Shicheng. Wude 2: Yinglong, Hongdu, Xiangyong, Wanzhi split. Wude 4: protectorate over Wu, Shi, Ye, Chen, Zhi, Zang, Chong, Ying, Zhuang, others. Same year: Fei from Xiangyong and Wanzhi; Yi from Dushang. Wude 10: Si's Gaofu here. Wude 11: Gaofu to Yi; Zhi's Xinning here. Now supervises fifteen prefectures including Si, Chen, Shi, Lao, Fei, Yi. Same year: protectorate abolished. Zhuangzhou protectorate-general established. Abolished; Bo as protectorate. Abolished; Qian again protectorate. Tianbao 1: Qianzhong commandery; protectorate over nine prefectures. Also fifty jimi prefectures including Chong, Ming, Lao, Xi, Fu, Jian, Zhuang, Zang, and others. All jimi, administered from valleys. In Qianyuan 1, Qianzhong Commandery again became the Qian Prefecture protectorate. Formerly five counties, 5,913 households, 27,433 mouths. Tianbao: six counties, 4,270 households, 24,204 mouths. 3,193 li south of capital, 3,271 li from Luoyang.

漢酉陽縣，屬武陵郡。 吳分西陽置黔陽郡。 隋于郡置彭水縣。 周置奉州，尋為黔州， 貞觀四年，于州置都督府。
Pengshui: Han Youyang, Wuling commandery. Wu split Xiyang for Qianyang commandery. Sui Pengshui at commandery. Zhou Feng Prefecture; soon Qian. In Zhenguan 4, a protectorate was set up at the prefecture.

隋分黔陽縣置石城縣。天寶元年，改為黔江。 武德二年，分置洪杜縣，治洪杜溪。麟德二年，移治龔湍。 武德二年，分彭水于巴江西置盈隆縣。先天元年，改為盈川。天寶元年，改為洋水。 隋置信安縣，取界內山名。武德二年，改為信寧。武德五年，屬義州。
Under the Sui, Shicheng County was established by splitting Qianyang County. In the first year of Tianbao, it was renamed Qianjiang. In the second year of Wude, Hongdu County was established by division, with its seat at Hongdu Creek. In the second year of Linde, the seat was moved to Gongtuan. In the second year of Wude, Yinglong County was established west of the Ba River by splitting Pengshui. In the first year of Xiantian, it was renamed Yingchuan. In the first year of Tianbao, it was renamed Yangshui. Under the Sui, Xin'an County was established and named for a mountain within its borders. In the second year of Wude, it was renamed Xinning. In the fifth year of Wude, it belonged to Yi Prefecture.

州廢來屬，
When Wurong abolished, assigned here.

貞觀二十年，分盈隆縣置。 辰州下，隋沅陵縣。武德四年，平蕭銑，置辰州，領沅陵等五縣。 九年，分大鄉置大鄉五縣。 五年，分辰溪置漵浦縣， 貞觀九年，分大鄉置三亭縣。天授二年，分大鄉、三亭兩縣置溪州。景雲二年，置都督府，督巫、業、錦三州。開元二十七年，罷都督府。天寶元年，改為盧溪郡。乾元元年，復為辰州，取溪名。 舊領縣七，戶九千二百八十三，口三萬九千二百二十五。 天寶領縣五，戶四千二百四十一，口二萬八千五百五十四。 在京師南微東三千四百五里，至東都三千二百六十里。
Tianbao 2: split from Yinglong. Chen Prefecture, lower grade: Sui Yuanling. Wude 4: Xiao Xian pacified; Chen with Yuanling and five others. Wude 9: five counties from Daxiang for Daxiang. Zhenguan 5: Xupu from Chenxi. In Zhenguan 9, Santing County was created from Daxiang. In Tianshou 2, Xi Prefecture was created from Daxiang and Santing. In Jingyun 2, a protectorate supervised Wu, Ye, and Jin. The protectorate was abolished in Kaiyuan 27. 漢辰陽縣，屬武陵郡，本秦黔中郡縣也。 隋改辰陽為辰溪，仍分置沅陵縣，仍置沅陵郡， 武德四年，改為辰州，以沅陵為理所 武德三年，分沅陵縣置。 漢義陵縣地，屬武陵郡。武德五年，分辰溪置。 武德三年，分沅陵、辰溪二縣置。垂拱四年，分置龍門縣，尋廢 漢辰陽縣地，隋分置辰溪縣。 錦州下，垂拱二年，分辰州麻陽縣地並開山洞置錦州及四縣。天寶元年，改錦州為盧陽郡。乾元元年，復為錦州。
Chenxi: Han Chenyang, Wuling; originally Qin Qianzhong. Sui Chenyang to Chenxi; Yuanling split; Yuanling commandery. Wude 4: Chen Prefecture; Yuanling seat. In the fifth year of Wude, it was established by splitting Chenxi. In the third year of Wude, it was established by splitting Yuanling and Chenxi counties. Jin Prefecture, lower grade: in the second year of Chuigong, land from Mayang County of Chen Prefecture was split off and mountain settlements were opened to establish Jin Prefecture and four counties. In the first year of Tianbao, Jin Prefecture was renamed Luyang Commandery. In the first year of Qianyuan, it again became Jin Prefecture.

天寶領縣五，戶二千八百七十二，口一萬四千三百七十四。 至京師三千五百里，至東都三千七百里。
