In the fourth year of Wude, pacification commissioner Ran Anchang said that Wuchuan lay on the key route to Zangke and requested that Wu Prefecture be established. In the fourth year of Zhenguan, it was renamed Si Prefecture, named for the Siqiong River. It was established in the third year of Wude and belonged to Si Prefecture. In the first year of Zhenguan, it was transferred to Wu Prefecture. In the fourth year, it was transferred to Si Prefecture. It was established under the Sui. In the fourth year of Wude, it belonged to Yi Prefecture. In the first year of Zhenguan, it belonged to Si Prefecture. In the fourth year of Kaiyuan, it was established by opening the territory of the unsubdued Lao. Fei Prefecture, lower grade: under the Sui this was Fuchuan County of Qian'an Commandery. In the fourth year of Zhenguan, Fuchuan and Fuyang counties of Si Prefecture were split off to establish Fei Prefecture.
284
其年，割黔州之萬資、相永二縣來屬。 八年，又割思州之多田、城樂來屬。 十一年，廢相永、萬資二縣， 天寶元年，復為涪川郡。乾元元年，復為費州。 舊領縣四，戶二千七百九，口六千九百五十。 天寶，戶四百二十九，口二千六百九。 在京師南四千七百里，至東都四千九百里。
Same year: Qian's Wanzhi and Xiangyong here. Zhenguan 8: Si's Duotian and Chengle here. Wude 11: Xiangyong and Wanzhi abolished. In Tianbao 1 it again became Fuchuan Commandery. In Qianyuan 1 it returned to Fei Prefecture. Formerly four counties, 2,709 households, 6,950 mouths. Tianbao: 429 households, 2,609 mouths. 4,700 li south of capital, 4,900 li to Luoyang.
285
漢牂柯郡之地，久不臣附。周宣政元年，信州總管、龍門公裕，招慰生獠王元殊、多質等歸國，乃置費州，以水為名。武德四年，置務州。貞觀四年，置費州治於此 武德四年，務州刺史奏置。
Han Zangke territory; long unsubmitted. Zhou: Duke Yu pacified Sheng Liao; Fei from river. Wude 4: Wu established. Wude 2: Fei seat here. Wu prefect memorialized establishment.
286
以土地稍平，懇田盈畛，故以多田為名， 貞觀四年，屬思州。八年，改屬費州 隋仁壽四年，庸州刺史奏置，以扶陽水為名 武德四年，山南道大使趙郡王孝恭招慰生獠，始築城，人歌舞之，故曰城樂。 南州下，武德二年置，領隆陽、扶化、隆巫、丹溪、靈水、南川六縣。
Land level; fields filled dikes; named Duotian. Zhenguan 8: Si. Zhenguan 8: Fei. Sui Yongzhou prefect memorialized; named for Fuyang River. Prince Xiaogong pacified Sheng Liao; first walled city; hence Chengle. Wude 4: Nan with six counties.
288
三年，改為僰州。 四年，復為南州， 貞觀五年，置三溪縣。 七年，又置當山、嵐山、歸德、汶溪四縣。 八年，又廢當山、嵐山、歸德、汶溪四縣。 十一年，又廢扶化、隆巫、靈水三縣， 天寶元年，改為南川郡。乾元元年，復為南州。 舊領縣三，戶三千五百八十三，口一萬三百六十六。 天寶領縣二，戶四百四十三，口二千四十三。 在京師南三千六百里，至東都三千七百里，
Zhenguan 3: Bo Prefecture. Zhenguan 4: Nan again. Zhenguan 5: Sanxi. Zhenguan 7: four counties also established. Zhenguan 8: four counties abolished again. Wude 11: three counties abolished. In Tianbao 1 it became Nanchuan Commandery. In Qianyuan 1 it returned to Nan Prefecture. Formerly three counties, 3,583 households, 10,366 mouths. Tianbao: two counties, 443 households, 2,043 mouths. 3,600 li south of capital, 3,700 li to Luoyang.
289
武德二年，置隆陽縣。先天元年，改為南川，州所治 貞觀五年置。 溪州下，舊辰州之大鄉。天授二年，分置溪州。
Longyang County was established in Wude 2. In Xiantian 1 it was renamed Nanchuan and served as the prefectural seat. It was established in Zhenguan 5. Xi Prefecture, lower grade: formerly Chen Prefecture's Daxiang. In Tianshou 2, Xi Prefecture was created from it.
290
舊領縣二，又分置洛浦縣， 長安四年，以洛浦屬錦州。天寶元年，改溪州為靈溪郡。乾元元年，復為溪州。 領縣二，戶二千一百八十四，口一萬五千二百八十二。 至京師二千八百九十三里，至東都二千六百九十六。
Formerly two counties; Luopu also split. In Chang'an 4, Luopu was assigned to Jin Prefecture. In Tianbao 1, Xi Prefecture became Lingxi Commandery, and in Qianyuan 1 it returned to Xi Prefecture. Two counties, 2,184 households, 15,282 mouths. 2,893 li to capital, 2,696 li to Luoyang.
291
漢沅陵、遷陵二縣地，屬武陵郡。 梁分置大鄉縣。 舊屬辰州，天授二年來屬，州所理也 貞觀九年分大鄉置，屬辰州。天授二年，改屬溪州。
Daxiang: Han Yuanling and Qianling, Wuling commandery. Liang split off Daxiang County. Formerly Chen; here; prefectural seat. Created from Daxiang in Zhenguan 9, it belonged to Chen Prefecture. In Tianshou 2, it was reassigned to Xi Prefecture.
292
縣界有黔山，大西、小西二山。 溱州下，貞觀十六年，置溱州及榮懿、扶歡、樂來三縣。咸亨元年，廢樂來縣。天寶元年，改為溱溪郡。乾元元年，復為溱州。 領縣二，戶八百七十九，口五千四十五。 至京師三千四百八十里，至東都四千二百里。
Mount Qian, Great West, and Little West within bounds. Qin Prefecture, lower grade: in Zhenguan 16, Qin Prefecture was established with Rongyi, Fuhuan, and Lelai. Lelai was abolished in Xianheng 1. In Tianbao 1 it became Qinxi Commandery, and in Qianyuan 1 it returned to Qin Prefecture. Two counties, 879 households, 5,045 mouths. 3,480 li to capital, 4,200 li to Luoyang.
293
扶歡已上二縣，並貞觀十六年開山洞置。 珍州下，貞觀十六年置，天寶元年改為夜郎郡。乾元元年，復為珍州。 領縣三，戶二百六十三，口一千三十四。 至京師四千一百里，至東都三千七百里。
Fuhuan and two above: opened caves. Zhen Prefecture, lower grade, was established in Zhenguan 16. In Tianbao 1 it became Yelang Commandery, and in Qianyuan 1 it returned to Zhen Prefecture. Three counties, 263 households, 1,034 mouths. 4,100 li to capital, 3,700 li to Luoyang.
294
漢夜郎郡之地。貞觀十七年，置於舊播州城，以縣界有隆珍山，因名珍州。麗皋樂源並貞觀十六年開山洞置。 ，領縣二 ，領縣八 ，領縣五 ，領縣四 ，領縣七。
Han Yelang commandery territory. At old Bo city; Longzhen Mountain in bounds; Zhen Prefecture. Ligao and Leyuan: opened caves. Two counties. Eight counties. Five counties. Four counties. Seven counties.
300
:已上國初置，並屬黔中道羈縻州。 永徽已後並省。 ，中，都督府，隋天水郡。武德二年，平薛舉。 改置秦州，仍立總管府，管秦、渭、岷、洮、疊、文、武、成、康、蘭、宕、扶等十二州。 秦州領上邽、成紀、秦嶺、清水四縣。 四年，分清水置邽州。 六年，廢邽州，以清水來屬。 八年，廢文州，又以隴城來屬。 其年，又廢伏州，以伏羌來屬。 九年，于成羌廢城置鹽泉縣， 貞觀元年，改鹽泉為夷賓。 二年，省夷賓縣。 六年，省長川縣。 十四年，督秦、萬、渭、武四州，治上邽。 十七年，廢秦嶺縣， 開元二十二年，緣地震，移治所于成紀縣之敬親川。天寶元年，改為天水郡。 依舊都督府，督天水、隴西、同穀三郡。 其年，復還治上邽， 乾元元年，復為秦州。 舊領縣六，戶五千七百二十四，口二萬五千七十三。 天寶領縣五，戶二萬四千八百二十七，口十萬九千七百。 在京師西七百八十里，至東都一千六百五里。
Above: founding jimi prefectures in Qianzhong Circuit. After Yonghui: all abolished. Qin Prefecture, middle protectorate, Longyou: Sui Tianshui commandery. Wude 4: Xue Ju pacified; Qin established; protectorate over twelve prefectures. Qin governed Shanggui, Chengji, Qinling, Qingshui. Wude 4: Gui from Qingshui. Wude 6: Gui abolished; Qingshui here. Wude 8: Wen abolished; Longcheng here. Same year: Fu abolished; Fuqiang here. Wude 9: Yanquan at abolished Fuqiang city. In the first year of Zhenguan, Tianbao 1: Yibin. Zhenguan 2: Yibin abolished. Zhenguan 6: Changchuan abolished. Zhenguan 14: supervised Qin, Wan, Wei, Wu; seat Shanggui. Zhenguan 17: Qinling abolished. Earthquake: seat to Jingqin Creek in Chengji. Tianbao 1: Tianshui commandery. Protectorate remained; Tianshui, Longxi, Tonggu. Same year: seat back to Shanggui. In Qianyuan 1, it returned to Qin Prefecture. Formerly six counties, 5,724 households, 25,073 mouths. Tianbao: five counties, 24,827 households, 109,700 mouths. 780 li west of capital, 1,605 li from Luoyang.
301
漢縣，屬隴西郡。 武帝分置天水郡。 後漢分豲道立南安郡。 後魏改上邽為上封。 隋復于上邽置秦州。 州前有湖水，四時增減，故名天水郡
Shanggui: Han county, Longxi commandery. Han Wu: Tianshui commandery. Later Han: Nan'an from Fuxian. Northern Wei: Shangfeng. Sui: Qin at Shanggui again. Lake before prefecture rises and falls seasonally; hence Tianshui.
302
漢縣，屬天水郡。 舊治小坑川， 開元二十二年，移治敬親川，成紀亦徙新城。天寶元年，州復移治上邽縣 漢冀縣，屬天水郡。
Chengji: Han county, Tianshui commandery. Former seat Xiaokeng Creek. Tianbao 1: seat Jingqin Creek; Chengji to Xincheng. Zhenyuan 2: seat back to Shanggui. Fuqiang: Han Ji, Tianshui commandery.
303
晉于此置秦州。 後魏改為當亭縣，隋復為冀城縣， 武德三年，改為伏羌縣，仍置伏州。 八年，伏州廢，縣屬秦州， 貞觀三年，廢夷賓縣，並入伏羌 漢隴縣，屬天水郡。
Jin: Qin Prefecture here. Northern Wei Dangting; Sui Jicheng. In the third year of Wude, Wude 4: Fuqiang; Fu Prefecture. Wude 8: Fu abolished; county to Qin. Zhenguan 2: Yibin into Fuqiang. Longcheng: Han Long, Tianshui commandery.
304
隋加「城」字， 武德二年，置文州，以隴城隸之。 八年文州廢，來屬， 貞觀三年，省長川縣併入。
The Sui added the character "城". In the second year of Wude, Wude 4: Wen; Longcheng subordinate. Wude 8: Wen abolished; here. In the third year of Zhenguan, Zhenguan 6: Changchuan merged in.
305
漢縣，屬天水郡， 武德四年，置邽州于清水。 六年，廢邽州，以清水來屬。 ，下，隋漢陽郡。武德元年，置成州，領上祿、長道、潭水三縣。貞觀元年，以潭水屬宕州，又割廢康州之同穀縣來屬。 州理楊難當所築建安城， 天寶元年，改為同穀郡。乾元元年，復為成州。 舊領縣三，戶一千五百四十六，口七千二百五十九。 天寶，戶四千七百二十七，口二萬一千五百八。 在京師西南九百六十里，至東都一千八百里。
Chengji: Han county, Tianshui commandery. Wude 4: Gui at Qingshui. Wude 6: Gui abolished; Qingshui here. Cheng Prefecture, lower grade: Sui Hanyang commandery. Wude 4: Cheng with Shanglu, Changdao, Tanshui. Zhenguan 6: Tanshui to Dang; Tonggu from Kang here. Seat at Yang Nanandang's Jian'an city. In Tianbao 1 it became Tonggu Commandery. In Qianyuan 1 it returned to Cheng Prefecture. Formerly three counties, 1,546 households, 7,259 mouths. Tianbao: 4,727 households, 21,508 mouths. 960 li southwest of capital, 1,800 li from Luoyang.
306
漢縣，屬武都郡，白馬氐之所處。 州南八十里仇池山，其上有百頃地，可處萬家。 晉時，氐酋楊難當據仇池，即此山上也。 晉朝招慰，乃置仇池郡，以難當為守。 梁置南秦州，又改為成州。 隋以上祿為倉泉縣，又復為上祿
Shanglu: Han county, Wudu; White Horse Di. Mount Qiuchi 80 li south; land for ten thousand households. Jin: Di chieftain Yang Nanandang held Qiuchi on this mountain. Jin pacified: Qiuchi commandery; Nanandang defender. Liang Southern Qin; later Cheng. Sui Shanglu to Cangquan; Shanglu again.
307
元魏分上祿置長道縣，於縣置天水郡。 隋改天水為漢陽郡，又改漢陽縣為長道
Northern Wei split Shanglu for Changdao; Tianshui commandery at county. Sui Tianshui to Hanyang commandery; Hanyang to Changdao.
308
漢下辨道，屬武都郡。 後魏於此置廣業郡，領白石縣。 又改白水為同穀。 ，下，隋隴西郡。武德元年，置渭州。天寶元年，改為隴西郡。乾元元年，復為渭州。 四月，鄯州都督郭英乂奏請以渭州、洮州為都督府，後廢。 舊領縣四，戶一千九百八十九，口九千二十八。 天寶，戶六千四百二十五，口二萬四千五百二十。 在京師西一千一百五十三里，至東都二千里。
Tonggu: Han Xiabian, Wudu commandery. Northern Wei Guangye commandery; Baishi. Again Baishui as Tonggu. Wei Prefecture, lower grade: Sui Longxi Commandery. It was established as Wei Prefecture in Wude 1, changed to Longxi Commandery in Tianbao 1, and restored as Wei Prefecture in Qianyuan 1. Fourth month: Guo Yingyi memorialized Wei and Tao protectorate; later abolished. Formerly four counties, 1,989 households, 9,028 mouths. Tianbao: 6,425 households, 24,520 mouths. 1,153 li west of capital, 2,000 li from Luoyang.
309
漢縣，屬隴西郡。後魏於縣置渭州，以水為名 漢豲音桓道地，屬天水郡。 漢分武陽置鄣縣。天授二年，改為武陽縣。神龍元年，復為鄣縣 漢首陽縣地，屬隴西郡。
Shanggui: Han county, Longxi commandery. Northern Wei Wei at county; named for river. Weiyuan: Han Fuxian, Tianshui commandery. Han split Wuyang for Zhang. Tianbao 1: Wuyang. Qianyuan 1: Zhang again. Heyuan: Han Shouyang, Longxi commandery.
312
後魏分隴西置渭源郡，又改首陽為渭源縣， 上元二年，改首陽縣，仍於渭源故城分置渭源縣。儀鳳三年，廢首陽併入渭源。 ，下都督府，隋西平郡。武德二年，平薛舉，置鄯州，治故樂都城。 貞觀中，置都督府， 天寶元年，改為西平郡。乾元元年，復為鄯州。上元二年九月，州為吐蕃所陷，遂廢。 所管鄯城三縣，今河州收管。 舊領縣二，戶一千八百七十五，口九千五百八十二。 天寶領縣三，戶五千三百八十九，口二萬七千一十九。 在京師西一千九百一十三，至東都二千五百四十里。
Northern Wei Heyuan commandery; Shouyang to Heyuan. Wude 4: Shouyang restored; Heyuan split from old city. Zhenguan 1: Shouyang into Heyuan. Shan Prefecture, lower protectorate: Sui Xiping commandery. Wude 4: Xue Ju pacified; Shan at old Ledu. Zhenguan: protectorate established. In Tianbao 1 it became Xiping Commandery. In Qianyuan 1 it returned to Shan Prefecture. In the ninth month of Shangyuan 2, it fell to the Tibetans and was abolished. Three Shan counties now under He. Formerly two counties, 1,875 households, 9,582 mouths. Tianbao: three counties, 5,389 households, 27,019 mouths. 1,913 li west of capital, 2,540 li to Luoyang.
313
漢破羌縣，屬金城郡。 漢破匈奴，取西河地，開湟中處月氏，即此。 湟水，俗呼湟河，又名樂都水，南涼禿發烏孤始都此。 後魏置鄯州，改破羌為西都縣。 隋改為湟水縣。 縣界有浩亹水
Shancheng: Han Poqiang, Jincheng commandery. Han broke Xiongnu; Western River; Yuezhi settled here. Huang River, also Ledu River; Southern Liang Wuji capital here. Northern Wei Shan; Poqiang to Xidu. Sui: Huangshui County. Hao River within bounds.
314
漢允吾縣，屬金城郡。 後漢改為龍耆縣。 後魏改為金城縣，又改為龍支。 積石山，在今縣南 儀鳳三年置，漢西平郡故城在西。 蘭州，下，隋金城郡。
Yunwu: Han Yunwu, Jincheng commandery. Later Han: Longqi. Northern Wei Jincheng then Longzhi. Mount Jishi south of county. Established; old Han Xiping city west. Lan Prefecture, lower grade: Sui Jincheng commandery.
315
隋末，陷薛舉， 武德二年，平賊，置蘭州。 八年，置都督府，督蘭、河、廓四州， 貞觀六年，又督西鹽州。 十二年，又督涼州。 今督蘭、鄯、儒、淳四州。 領金城、狄道、廣武三縣， 顯慶元年，罷都督府。天寶元年，改金城郡。 二載，割狄道縣置狄道郡， 乾元元年，復為蘭州。 舊領縣三，戶一千六百七十五，口七千三百五。 天寶領縣二，戶二千八百八十九，口一萬四千二百二十六。 在京師西一千四百四十五里，至東都二千二百里。
Sui end: Xue Ju. In the second year of Wude, Wude 4: rebels pacified; Lan established. Wude 8: protectorate over Lan, He, Kuo, four prefectures. In the sixth year of Zhenguan, Also Western Yan. Twelfth year: also Liang. Now Lan, Shan, Ru, Chun. Jincheng, Didao, Guangwu. In Zhenguan 1 the protectorate was abolished. Tianbao 1: Jincheng commandery. Qianyuan 2: Didao commandery. In Qianyuan 1, it returned to Lan Prefecture. Formerly three counties, 1,675 households, 7,305 mouths. Tianbao: two counties, 2,889 households, 14,226 mouths. 1,445 li west of capital, 2,200 li to Luoyang.
316
漢金城縣，屬金城郡，西羌所處。 後漢置西海郡，乞伏乾歸都此，稱涼。 隋開皇初，置蘭州，以皋蘭山為名。 煬帝改金城郡。 隋置五泉縣， 咸亨二年，復為金城。天寶元年，改為五泉。 漢枝楊縣，屬金城郡。
Jincheng: Han Jincheng; Western Qiang. Later Han Western Sea; Guixin capital as Liang. Early Sui Lan; Mount Gaolan. Yang: Jincheng commandery. Sui: Wuquan County. Tianbao 1: Jincheng again. Qianyuan 1: Wuquan. Didao: Han Zhiyang, Jincheng commandery.
317
張駿置廣武郡。 隋廢為縣，屬蘭州。 ，下，都督府，天寶三載，分金城郡置狄道郡。乾元元年，改為臨州都督府，督保塞州，羈縻之名也。 領縣二，戶二千八百九十九，口一萬四千二百二十六。 在京師西一千四百四十五里，至東都二千二百里。
Zhang Jun: Guangwu commandery. Sui: county; Lan. Lin, lower protectorate: Tianbao 3 Didao commandery from Jincheng. Qianyuan 2: Lin protectorate; Baosai jimi. Two counties, 2,899 households, 14,226 mouths. 1,445 li west of capital, 2,200 li to Luoyang.
318
漢縣，屬隴西郡。 晉改為武始縣。 隋復為狄道，屬蘭州。 天寶三載復置。
Shanggui: Han county, Longxi commandery. Jin: Wushi. Sui Didao; Lan. Tianbao 3: restored.
319
舊安樂縣。 乾元後，改為長樂。 ，下，隋枹音桴罕郡。武德二年，平李軌，置河州，領枹罕、大夏二縣。貞觀元年，廢大夏縣。 五年復置。 十年，省米州，以米川縣來屬。 十一年，廢烏州，以其城置安鄉縣，來屬， 天寶元年，改為安鄉郡。乾元元年，復為河州。 舊領縣三，戶三千三百九十一，口一萬二千六百五十五。 天寶領縣三，戶五千七百八十二，口三萬六千八百八十六。 在京師西一千四百一十五里，至東都二千二百七十里。
Formerly Anle. After Qianyuan: Changle. He Prefecture, lower grade: Sui Fuhan Commandery. In Wude 2, after Li Gui was pacified, He Prefecture was created with Fuhan and Daxia. Daxia County was abolished in Zhenguan 1. Fifth year: restored. Wude 10: Mi abolished; Michuan here. Wude 11: Wu abolished; Anxiang at its city here. In Tianbao 1 it became Anxiang Commandery. In Qianyuan 1 it returned to He Prefecture. Formerly three counties, 3,391 households, 12,655 mouths. Tianbao: three counties, 5,782 households, 36,886 mouths. 1,415 li west of capital, 2,270 li to Luoyang.
320
漢縣，屬金城郡。 張駿於縣置河州，至後魏不改，又名枹罕郡。 隋初為河州，煬帝為枹罕郡， 武德二年，改為河州。 皆治於枹罕。
Fuhan: Han county, Jincheng commandery. Zhang Jun He at county; through Northern Wei; Fuhan commandery. Early Sui He; Yang Fuhan commandery. In the second year of Wude, Wude 4: He Prefecture. All from Fuhan.
321
漢縣，屬隴西郡。 張駿于縣置大夏郡及縣，取西大夏水為名， 貞觀元年，廢入枹罕。 五年又置。
Shanggui: Han county, Longxi commandery. Zhang Jun Daxia commandery and county; Western Daxia River. In Zhenguan 1, it was merged into Fuhan. Fifth year: restored.
322
漢白石縣，屬金城郡。 張駿改白石為永固， 貞觀七年，廢縣，置烏州。 十一年州廢，於城內置安鄉縣， 天寶元年，改為鳳林，取關名也。 ，下，隋武都郡。武德元年，置武州，領將利、建威、覆津、盤堤四縣。貞觀元年，省建威入將利。天寶元年，改為武都郡。乾元元年，復為武州。 舊領縣三，戶一千一百五十二，口五千三百八十一。 天寶，戶二千九百二十三，口一萬五千三百一十三。 在京師西一千二百九十里，至東都二千里。
Michuan: Han Baishi, Jincheng commandery. Zhang Jun: Baishi to Yonggu. In the seventh year of Zhenguan, Wude 4: county abolished; Wu Prefecture. Wude 11: Wu abolished; Anxiang in city. Tianbao 1: Fenglin, from pass name. Wu Prefecture, lower grade: Sui Wudu Commandery. In Wude 1, Wu Prefecture was created with Jiangli, Jianwei, Fujin, and Pandi. Jianwei was merged into Jiangli in Zhenguan 1. In Tianbao 1 it became Wudu Commandery, and in Qianyuan 1 it returned to Wu Prefecture. Formerly three counties, 1,152 households, 5,381 mouths. Tianbao: 2,923 households, 15,313 mouths. 1,290 li west of capital, 2,000 li to Luoyang.
323
秦、漢白馬之地。 漢置武都郡並縣。 後魏改武都為石門縣，置武州。 後周改為將利縣，仍置武都郡。 隋初廢，煬帝復為郡，皆治將利縣。
Qin and Han White Horse Di land. Han Wudu commandery and county. Northern Wei Shimen; Wu Prefecture. Northern Zhou Jiangli; Wudu commandery. Early Sui abolished; Yang restored; all Jiangli.
324
後魏置武階郡，又於今縣東北三十里萬郡故城置覆津縣。 隋廢武階郡，縣屬武都郡。
Northern Wei Wujie; Fujin at old Wanjun city. Sui Wujie abolished; county to Wudu commandery.
325
漢河池縣地，屬武都郡。 後魏於今縣東南百四十二里移盤堤縣于郡置武州。 盤堤山為名。 ，下，隋臨洮郡。武德二年，置洮州。貞觀五年，移州治于洪和城，後復移還洮陽城，今州治也。永徽元年，置都督府。開元十七年廢，併入岷州。 臨潭縣置臨州。 二十七年，又改為洮州， 天寶元年，改為臨洮郡。 管密恭縣，党項部落也，寄治州界， 乾元元年，復為洮州。 舊領縣二，戶二千三百六十三，口八千二百六十。 天寶，戶三千七百，口一萬五千六十。 在京師西一千五百六里，至東都二千三百九十里。
Pandi: Han Hechi, Wudu commandery. Northern Wei moved Pandi; Wu at commandery. Named for Mount Pandi. Tao Prefecture, lower grade: Sui Lintao Commandery. Tao Prefecture was established in Wude 2. In Zhenguan 5, the seat moved to Honghe and later back to Taoyang, the present seat. A protectorate was created in Yonghui 1, then abolished in Kaiyuan 17 and merged into Min Prefecture. Lingtan: Lin Prefecture. Kaiyuan 27: Tao again. Tianbao 1: Lintao commandery. Migong: Tangut tribe; administered in bounds. In Qianyuan 1, it returned to Tao Prefecture. Formerly two counties, 2,363 households, 8,260 mouths. Tianbao: 3,700 households, 15,060 mouths. 1,506 li west of capital, 2,390 li to Luoyang.
326
秦、漢時羌地，本吐谷渾之鎮，謂之洪和城。 後周攻得之，改為美相縣，屬洮州， 貞觀四年，洮州理於此。 置臨潭縣，屬旭州。 八年，廢旭州，來屬。 其年，移理洮陽城，今州治也。 仍于舊洪和城置美相縣，隸洮州。 天寶中，廢美相併入。 ，下，隋臨洮郡之臨洮縣。義寧二年，置岷州。武德四年，為總管府，管岷、宕、洮、疊、旭五州。 七年，加督芳州。 九年，又督文、武、扶三州， 貞觀元年，督岷、宕、洮、旭四州。 六年，督橋、意二州。 十二年，廢都督府， 神龍元年，廢當夷縣。天寶元年，改為和政郡。乾元元年，復為岷州。 舊領縣四，戶四千五百八十三，口一萬九千二百三十九。 天寶，縣三，戶四千三百二十五，口二萬三千四百四十一。 在京師西一千三百七十八里，至東都二千一百里。
Qin and Han Di land; Tuyuhun Honghe garrison. Northern Zhou captured; Meixiang; Tao. Zhenguan 4: Tao seat here. Lingtan; Xu. Zhenguan 8: Xu abolished; here. Same year: seat Taoyang; present seat. Meixiang at old Honghe; Tao. Tianbao: Meixiang merged in. Min Prefecture, lower grade: Sui Lintao in Lintao commandery. Wude 4: Min established. Wude 5: protectorate-general over five prefectures. Wude 7: Fang added. Wude 9: also Wen, Wu, Fu. In the first year of Zhenguan, Zhenguan 9: Min, Dang, Tao, Xu. Zhenguan 6: Qiao and Yi. Zhenguan 12: protectorate-general abolished. Dangyi County was abolished in Shenlong 1. In Tianbao 1 it became Hezheng Commandery, and in Qianyuan 1 it returned to Min Prefecture. Formerly four counties, 4,583 households, 19,239 mouths. Tianbao: three counties, 4,325 households, 23,441 mouths. 1,378 li west of capital, 2,100 li to Luoyang.
327
秦臨洮縣，屬隴西郡。 今州西二十里長城，蒙恬所築。 岷山，在縣南一里。 崆峒山，縣西二十里。 後魏置岷州，仍改臨洮為溢樂。 隋復改臨洮，義寧二年，改名溢樂。神龍元年，廢當夷縣併入 後周置基城縣。先天元年，改為祐川，避玄宗名 後周置洮城郡。保定元年，置和政縣。 ，下，隋澆河郡。武德二年，置廓州。天寶元年，改為寧塞郡。乾元元年，復為廓州。
Qin Lintao, Longxi commandery. 20 li west: Long Wall of Meng Tian. Mount Min 1 li south. Mount Kongtong 20 li west. Northern Wei Min; Lintao to Yile. Under the Sui it was again renamed Lintao. In the second year of Yining, it was renamed Yile. In the first year of Shenlong, Dangyi County was abolished and merged in. Northern Zhou established Jicheng County. In the first year of Xiantian, it was renamed Youchuan to avoid Xuanzong's personal name. Northern Zhou established Taocheng Commandery. In the first year of Baoding, Hezheng County was established. Kuo Prefecture, lower grade: under the Sui this was Jiaohe Commandery. In the second year of Wude, Kuo Prefecture was established. In the first year of Tianbao, it was renamed Ningsai Commandery. In the first year of Qianyuan, it again became Kuo Prefecture.
329
舊領縣二，戶二千二十，口九千七百三十二。 天寶，縣三，戶四千二百六十一，口二萬四千四百。 在京師二千三十里，至東都二千七百七十二里。
Formerly two counties, 2,020 households, 9,732 mouths. Tianbao: three counties, 4,261 households, 24,400 mouths. 2,030 li from capital, 2,772 li to Luoyang.
330
後漢燒當羌之地，段熲破羌斬澆河大帥即此也。 漢末，置西平郡，此地即南界也。 前涼置湟河郡。 後魏置石城郡。 廢帝因縣內化隆穀改為化隆縣。 後周置廓州， 先天元年，改為化成縣。 天寶元年，改為廣威縣。 縣界有拔延山。 達化後周置達化郡並縣。 吐渾澆河城，在縣西一百二十里。 米川漢枹罕縣地，屬金城郡， 貞觀五年，置米州及米川縣。 十年，州廢，縣屬廓州。 ，下，都督府，隋臨洮郡之合川縣。武德二年，置疊州，領合川、樂川、疊川三縣。 五年，又置安化、和同二縣，以處党項，尋省。 疊川、樂川縣。 十三年，置都督，督疊、岷、洮、宕、津、序、壹、枯、嶂、王、蓋、立、橋等州， 永徽元年，罷都督府。天寶元年，改為合川郡。乾元元年，復為疊州。 舊領縣一，戶一千八十三，口四千六十九。 天寶領縣二，戶一千二百七十五，口七千六百七十四。 在京師西南一千一百一十里，至東都二千五百六十里。
Later Han Shaodang Qiang; Duan Jiong beheaded Raohe chieftain here. Han end Western Ping; southern border here. Former Liang Huanghe commandery. Northern Wei Shicheng commandery. Emperor Fei: Hualong Valley; Hualong County. Northern Zhou Kuo. In the first year of Xiantian, it was renamed Huacheng County. In the first year of Tianbao, it was renamed Guangwei County. Mount Bayan in bounds. Dahua: Northern Zhou commandery and county. Tuyuhun Raohe city 120 li west. Michuan: Han Fuhan, Jincheng commandery. In the fifth year of Zhenguan, Wude 4: Mi Prefecture and Michuan. Wude 10: Mi abolished; county to Kuo. Die Prefecture, lower protectorate: Sui Hechuan in Lintao commandery. Wude 4: Die with three counties. Wude 5: Anhua and Hetong for Tangut; soon abolished. Diechuan and Lechuan counties. Wude 13: protectorate over many prefectures. The protectorate was abolished in Yonghui 1. In Tianbao 1 it became Hechuan Commandery, and in Qianyuan 1 it returned to Die Prefecture. Formerly one county, 1,083 households, 4,069 mouths. Tianbao: two counties, 1,275 households, 7,674 mouths. 1,110 li southwest of capital, 2,560 li to Luoyang.
331
秦、漢已來，為諸羌保據。 後周武帝逐諸羌，始有其地，置合川縣，仍於縣置疊州，取郡山重疊之義。 舊治吐谷渾馬牧城，武德三年，移於交戍城 隋同昌郡之常芬縣。武德元年，置芳州，領常芬、恆香、丹嶺三縣。神龍元年，廢芳州為常芬縣，隸疊州。 ，下，隋宕昌郡。武德元年，置宕州。
Since Qin and Han various Qiang stronghold. Northern Zhou Wu drove Qiang; Hechuan and Die from overlapping mountains. Former Tuyuhun horse city; Wude 4 Jiaoshu. Sui Tongchang Changfen. Wude 4: Fang with three counties. Zhenguan 8: Fang to Changfen; Die. Dang Prefecture, lower grade: Sui Dangchang commandery. Wude 4: Dang established.
332
領懷道、良恭、和戎三縣， 貞觀三年，省和戎入懷道。天寶元年，改為懷道郡。乾元元年，復為宕州。 舊領縣二，戶一百四十，口一千四百六十一。 天寶，戶一千一百九十，口七千一百九十九。 在京師西南一千六百五十六里，至東都二千二百八十五里。
Huaidao, Lianggong, Herong. Herong was merged into Huaidao in Zhenguan 3. In Tianbao 1 it became Huaidao Commandery, and in Qianyuan 1 it returned to Dang Prefecture. Formerly two counties, 140 households, 1,461 mouths. Tianbao: 1,190 households, 7,199 mouths. 1,656 li southwest of capital, 2,285 li to Luoyang.
333
歷代諸羌所據，後魏始附為蕃國。 後周置宕昌郡，及懷道、良恭二縣。 隋為宕昌郡。 武德初，為宕州，理懷道 後周置陽宕縣，隋改為良恭。 道，不在十道之內。景雲二年，以江山闊遠，奉使者艱難，乃分山南為東西道，自黃河以西，分為河西道。 ，大都督府，隋武威郡。武德二年，平李軌，置涼州總管府，管涼、甘、瓜、肅四州。
Various Qiang; Northern Wei frontier state. Northern Zhou Dangchang; Huaidao and Lianggong. Sui Dangchang commandery. Wude: Dang; seat Huaidao. Northern Zhou Yangdang; Sui Lianggong. Hexi Circuit: outside the ten circuits. Vast distance; south split east-west; west of Yellow River Hexi. Liang Prefecture, great protectorate: Sui Wuwei commandery. Wude 4: Li Gui pacified; Liang protectorate over four prefectures.
334
涼州領姑臧、昌松、番禾三縣。 三年，又置神烏縣。 七年，改為都督府，督涼、肅、甘、沙、瓜、伊、芳、文八州， 貞觀元年，廢神烏縣。總章元年，復置。咸亨元年，為凉州大都督府。 督涼、甘、肅、伊、瓜、沙、雄七州， 上元二年，為中都督府。神龍二年，置嘉麟縣。天寶元年，改為武威郡，督涼、甘、肅三州。乾元元年，復為涼州。 舊領縣三，戶八千二百三十一，口三萬三千三十。 天寶領縣五，戶二萬二千四百六十二，口十二萬二百八十一。 在京師西北二千一十里，至東都二千八百七十里。
Liang: Guzang, Changsong, Fanhe. Wude 3: Shenwu also. Wude 7: protectorate-general over eight prefectures. Zhenguan 1: Shenwu abolished. Wude 7: re-established. Zhenguan 2: Liangzhou great protectorate. Supervised seven prefectures. In Shangyuan 2, it became a middle regional military commission. In Shenlong 2, Jialin County was created. In Tianbao 1 it became Wuwei Commandery, overseeing Liang, Gan, and Su; in Qianyuan 1 it returned to Liang Prefecture. Formerly three counties, 8,231 households, 33,030 mouths. Tianbao: five counties, 22,462 households, 120,281 mouths. 2,110 li northwest of capital, 2,870 li to Luoyang.
335
漢縣，屬武威郡。 所理，秦月氐戎所處。 匈奴本名蓋藏城，語訛為姑臧城。 西魏復置涼州。 晉末，張軌據姑臧，稱前涼。 呂光又稱後涼。 後入于元魏，為武威郡。 武德初，平李軌，置涼州。 州界有豬野澤
Guzang: Han county, Wuwei commandery. Seat; Qin Yuezhi Rong. Xiongnu Gaizang; corrupted to Guzang. Western Wei Liang restored. Jin end Zhang Gui Former Liang at Guzang. Lü Guang Later Liang. Later Northern Wei Wuwei commandery. Wude: Li Gui pacified; Liang. Lake Zhuye in bounds.
336
漢鸞鳥縣，屬武威郡。 後魏廢， 總章元年，復于漢武威城置武威縣。神龍元年，改為神烏。於漢鸞鳥古城置嘉麟縣 漢蒼松縣，屬武威郡。後涼呂光改為昌松 漢番音盤禾縣，屬張掖郡。
Shenwu: Han Luaniao, Wuwei. Northern Wei abolished. Wude 4: Wuwei at old Han city. Tianbao 1: Shenwu. Zhenguan 2: Jialin at old Luaniao. Changsong: Han Cangsong, Wuwei. Later Liang Lü Guang: Changsong. Fanhe: Han Panhe, Zhangye commandery.
338
縣南山曰天山，又名雪山， 咸亨元年，於縣置雄州，調露元年，廢雄州，番禾還涼州。天寶三年，改為天寶縣 神龍二年，於漢鸞鳥古城置。景龍二年廢，先天二年復置 :已上八州府，並無縣，皆吐渾、契苾、思結等部，寄在涼州界內。
Mount Tianshan south, also Snow. In the first year of Xianheng, Xiong Prefecture was established at the county. In the first year of Tiaolu, Xiong Prefecture was abolished and Fanhe returned to Liang Prefecture. In the third year of Tianbao, it was renamed Tianbao County. In the second year of Shenlong, it was established at the old Han city of Luanniao. It was abolished in the second year of Jinglong and re-established in the second year of Xiantian. The above eight prefectural offices had no counties; they were all Tuyuhun, Qibi, Sijie, and other tribal groups, lodged within the borders of Liang Prefecture.
340
共有戶五千四十八，口一萬七千二百一十二。 ，下，隋張掖郡。武德二年，平李軌，置甘州。天寶元年，改為張掖郡。乾元元年，復為甘州。 舊領縣二，戶二千九百二十六，口一萬一千六百八十。 天寶，戶六千二百八十四，口二萬二千九十二。 在京師西北二千五百里，至東都三千三百一十里。
Together 5,048 households, 17,212 mouths. Gan Prefecture, lower grade: Sui Zhangye Commandery. In Wude 2, after Li Gui was pacified, Gan Prefecture was created. In Tianbao 1 it became Zhangye Commandery, and in Qianyuan 1 it returned to Gan Prefecture. Formerly two counties, 2,926 households, 11,680 mouths. Tianbao: 6,284 households, 22,092 mouths. 2,500 li northwest of capital, 3,310 li to Luoyang.
341
故匈奴昆邪王地，屬漢武開置張掖郡及觻音祿得縣，郡所治也，匈奴王號也。 後魏置張掖軍，孝文改為郡及縣，州置西涼州，尋改為甘州，取州東甘峻山為名。 祁連山，在州西南二百里也
Xiongnu Kunye; Han Wu Zhangye and Lude; Xiongnu royal title. Northern Wei Zhangye army; Xiaowen commandery; Western Liang then Gan; Mount Ganjun. Mount Qilian 200 li southwest.
342
漢縣，屬張掖郡。 後漢分張掖置西海郡。 晉分刪丹置蘭池、萬歲、仙提三縣。 煬帝廢，併入刪丹。 居延海、焉支山在縣界。 刪丹山，即焉支山，語訛也。 ，下，武德二年，分隋張掖郡置肅州。 八年，置都督府，督肅、瓜、沙三州， 貞觀元年，罷都督府。 貞觀中，廢玉門縣， 天寶元年，改為酒泉郡。乾元元年，復為肅州。 舊領縣三，戶一千七百三十一，口七千一百一十八。 天寶領縣二，戶二千三百三十，口八千四百七十六。 在京師西北二千八百五十八里，至東都三千七百八里。
Shandan: Han county, Zhangye commandery. Later Han split Zhangye for Western Sea. Jin split Shandan for three counties. Yang abolished; into Shandan. Lake Juyan and Mount Yanzhi in bounds. Mount Shandan is Mount Yanzhi; corrupted. Su Prefecture, lower grade: Zhenguan 8 from Zhangye. Wude 8: protectorate over Su, Gua, Sha. Zhenguan 1: protectorate abolished. Zhenguan: Yumen abolished. In Tianbao 1 it became Jiuquan Commandery. In Qianyuan 1 it returned to Su Prefecture. Formerly three counties, 1,731 households, 7,118 mouths. Tianbao: two counties, 2,330 households, 8,476 mouths. 2,858 li northwest of capital, 3,708 li to Luoyang.
343
漢福祿縣，屬酒泉郡。 郡城下有金泉，泉味如酒，故為郡名。 此月支地，為匈奴所滅，匈奴令休屠、昆邪王守之。 漢武時，昆邪來降，乃置酒泉郡。 張軌、李暠、沮渠蒙遜皆都於此。 後魏置酒泉軍，復為郡，後周改為甘州，隋分甘州置肅州，皆治酒泉。 義甯元年，置酒泉縣
Jiuquan: Han Fulu, Jiuquan commandery. Golden Spring below city tastes like wine; hence name. Yuezhi land; Xiongnu destroyed; Xiutu and Kunye guarded. Han Wu: Kunye submitted; Jiuquan commandery. Zhang Gui, Li Gao, Juqu Mengxun capitals here. Northern Wei Jiuquan army; Northern Zhou Gan; Sui Su from Gan; all Jiuquan. Yining 1: Jiuquan County.
344
漢舊縣，屬酒泉郡。 今縣，漢樂涫縣地，屬燉煌郡， 武德二年，于樂涫古城置福祿縣。 ，下，都督府，隋燉煌郡之常樂縣。武德五年，置瓜州，仍立總管府，管西沙、肅三州。 八年。 罷都督。 貞觀中，復為都督府， 天寶元年，為晉昌郡。乾元元年，復為瓜州。 舊領縣二，戶一千一百六十四，口四千三百二十二。 天寶，戶四百七十七，口四千九百八十七。 在京師西三千三百一十里，至東都四千三百六里。
Old Han county, Jiuquan commandery. Present county: Han Lequan, Dunhuang commandery. Wude 4: Fulu at old Lequan city. Gua Prefecture, lower protectorate: Sui Changle in Dunhuang commandery. Wude 5: Gua; protectorate over Western Sha and Su. Wude 8. Zhenguan 5: protectorate abolished. Zhenguan: protectorate again. In Tianbao 1 it became Jinchang Commandery. In Qianyuan 1 it returned to Gua Prefecture. Formerly two counties, 1,164 households, 4,322 mouths. Tianbao: 477 households, 4,987 mouths. 3,310 li west of capital, 4,306 li to Luoyang.
345
漢冥安縣，屬燉煌郡。 冥，水名。 置晉昌郡及冥安縣，周改晉昌為永興。 隋改為瓜州，改冥安常樂， 武德七年，復為晉昌 漢廣至縣，屬燉煌郡。
Jinxing: Han Ming'an, Dunhuang commandery. Ming: river name. Jin Jinchang and Ming'an; Zhou Yongxing. Sui Gua; Ming'an to Changle. Tianbao 1: Jinchang again. Guangzhi: Han Guangzhi, Dunhuang commandery.
346
魏分廣至置宜禾縣。 李暠於此置涼興郡。 隋廢，置常樂鎮， 武德五年，改鎮為縣。 伊州，下，隋伊吾郡。 隋末，西域雜胡據之， 貞觀四年，歸化，置西伊州。 六年，去「西」字， 天寶元年，為伊吾郡。乾元元年，復為伊州。 舊領縣三，戶一千三百三十二，口六千七百七十八。 天寶領縣二，戶二千四百六十七，口一萬一百五十七。 在京師西北四千四百一十六里，至東都五千三百三十里。
Wei split Guangzhi for Yihe. Li Gao Liangxing commandery. Sui abolished; Changle garrison. Wude 4: garrison to county. Yi Prefecture, lower grade: Sui Yiwu commandery. Sui end: Western Regions Hu held it. In the fourth year of Zhenguan, Wude 4: submitted; Western Yi. In the sixth year of Wude, the character "西" was dropped. In Tianbao 1 it became Yiwu Commandery. In Qianyuan 1 it returned to Yi Prefecture. Formerly three counties, 1,332 households, 6,778 mouths. Tianbao: two counties, 2,467 households, 10,157 mouths. 4,416 li northwest of capital, 5,330 li to Luoyang.
347
在燉煌之北，大磧之外。 秦、漢之際，戎居之。 南去玉門關八百里，東去陽關二千七百三十里。 漢宣帝時，以鄭吉為都護，在玉門關。 元帝時，置戊己校尉，皆治車師。 後漢明帝時，取伊吾盧地，置宜禾都尉以屯田。 竇憲、班超大破西域，始於此築城。 班勇為西域長史，居此地也。 後魏、後周，鄯善戎居之。 隋始于漢伊吾屯城之東築城，為伊吾郡。 隋末，為戎所據， 貞觀四年，款附，置西伊州始於此。天山，在州北一百二十里，一名白山，胡人呼折羅漫山 貞觀四年置，取縣東柔遠故城為名 貞觀四年，于鄯善胡所築之城置納職縣。 ，下，隋燉煌郡。武德二年，置瓜州。
North of Dunhuang beyond great desert. Qin and Han Rong here. 800 li south of Yumen; 2,730 li east of Yang Pass. Han Xuan: Zheng Ji Protector-General at Yumen. Han Yuan: Wuji Colonel; both Cheshi. Later Han Ming: Yiquan land; Yihe Colonel for farming. Dou Xian and Ban Chao defeated Western Regions; first city here. Ban Yong Western Regions Chief Clerk; dwelt here. Northern Wei and Northern Zhou Shanshan Rong here. Sui built east of Han Yiwu garrison; Yiwu commandery. Sui end: held by Rong. Wude 4: submitted; Western Yi first here. Mount Tianshan 120 li north, also Bai; Hu Zheluoman. Established; from old Rouyuan east of county. Wude 4: Nazhi at Shanshan Hu city. Sha Prefecture, lower grade: Sui Dunhuang Commandery. In Wude 2, Gua Prefecture was established.
349
五年，改為西沙州， 貞觀七年，去「西」字。天寶元年，改為燉煌郡。乾元元年，復為沙州。 舊領縣二，戶四千二百六十五，口一萬六千二百五十。 在京師西北三千六百五十里，至東都四千三百九里。
Wude 5: Western Sha. In Zhenguan 7, "west" was dropped from the name. In Tianbao 1 it became Dunhuang Commandery, and in Qianyuan 1 it returned to Sha Prefecture. Formerly two counties, 4,265 households, 16,250 mouths. 3,650 li northwest of capital, 4,309 li to Luoyang.
350
漢郡縣名。 月氐戎之地，秦、漢之際來屬。 漢武開西域，分酒泉置燉煌郡及縣。 周改燉煌為鳴沙縣，取縣界山名。 隋復為燉煌， 武德三年，置瓜州，取《春秋》「祖吾離於瓜州」之義。 五年，改為西沙州。 皆治于三危山，在縣東南二十里。 鳴沙山，一名沙角山，又名神沙山，取州名焉，在縣七里
Dunhuang: Han commandery and county names. Yuezhi Rong land; Qin and Han submission. Han Wu opened Western Regions; Dunhuang commandery from Jiuquan. Zhou Dunhuang to Mingsha; mountain name. Sui Dunhuang again. In the third year of Wude, Gua Prefecture was established, taking the meaning of the Spring and Autumn phrase "Zu Wu departed at Gua Prefecture." Wude 5: Western Sha. All at Mount Sanwei 20 li southeast. Mount Mingsha, also Shajiao and Shensha; gives prefecture name; 7 li from county.
351
漢龍勒縣地，屬燉煌郡。 縣南有龍勒山。 後魏改為壽昌縣。 陽關，在縣西六里。 玉門關，在縣西北一百一十八里。 ，中，都督府，本高昌國。貞觀十三年，平高昌，置西州都督府，仍立五縣。顯慶三年，改為都督府。天寶元年，改為交河郡。乾元元年，復為西州。 舊領縣五，戶六千四百六十六。 天寶領縣五，戶九千一十六，口四萬九千四百七十六。 在京師西北五千五百一十六里，至東都六千二百一十五里。
Shouchang: Han Longle, Dunhuang commandery. Mount Longle south of county. Northern Wei Shouchang. Yang Pass 6 li west. Yumen Pass 118 li northwest. Xi Prefecture, middle grade protectorate: originally the Gaochang kingdom. In Zhenguan 13, after Gaochang was pacified, the Xi Prefecture protectorate and five counties were established. In Xianqing 3 it became a protectorate. In Tianbao 1 it became Jiaohe Commandery, and in Qianyuan 1 it returned to Xi Prefecture. Formerly five counties, 6,466 households. Tianbao: five counties, 9,016 households, 49,476 mouths. 5,516 li northwest of capital, 6,215 li to Luoyang.
352
漢車師前王之庭。 漢元帝置戊己校尉于此。 以其地形高敞，故名高昌。 其故壘有八城。 張駿置高昌郡，後魏因之。 魏末為蠕蠕所據，後麹嘉稱高昌王於此數代， 貞觀十四年，討平之，以其地為西州。 其高昌國境，東西八百里，南北五百里。 尋置都督府，又改為金山都督府。
Gaochang: Former Cheshi court. Han Yuan: Wuji Colonel here. High open terrain; hence Gaochang. Old ramparts: eight cities. Zhang Jun Gaochang commandery; Northern Wei followed. Wei end Ruru; Qu Jia Gaochang king for generations. In the fourteenth year of Zhenguan, Zhenguan 9: pacified; Xi Prefecture. Gaochang bounds 800 li east-west, 500 li north-south. Soon protectorate; then Jinshan protectorate.
353
貞觀十四年置 縣界有交河，水源出縣北天山，一名祁連山，縣取水名。地本漢車師前王庭 貞觀十四年，於始昌故城置，縣東南有蒲類海，胡人呼為婆悉海 貞觀十四年置，取祁連山為名。 雄州，凉州界内。 文州，凉州界内。 芳州，凉州界内。 北庭都護府，貞觀十四年，侯君集討高昌，西突厥屯兵於浮圖城，與高昌相回應。
It was established in the fourteenth year of Zhenguan. Within the county borders was the Jiao River, whose source was Mount Tianshan north of the county, also called Mount Qilian; the county took its name from the river. The land was originally the former royal court of Han Cheshi. In the fourteenth year of Zhenguan, it was established at the old city of Shichang. Southeast of the county was Lake Pulei, which the Hu people called Lake Bosi. It was established in the fourteenth year of Zhenguan and named for Mount Qilian. Xiong Prefecture in Liang bounds. Wen Prefecture in Liang bounds. Fang Prefecture in Liang bounds. Beiting Protectorate: in the fourteenth year of Zhenguan, when Hou Junji campaigned against Gaochang, the Western Turks stationed troops at Fotu City and coordinated with Gaochang.
356
及高昌平。 二十年四月，西突厥泥伏沙缽羅葉護阿史那賀魯率眾內附，乃置庭州，處葉護部落， 長安二年，改為北庭都護府。 自永徽至天寶，北庭節度使管鎮兵二萬人，馬五千匹； 所統攝突騎施、堅昆、斬啜； 又管瀚海、天山、伊吾三軍鎮兵萬余人，馬五千匹。 至上元元年，陷吐蕃。 舊領縣一，戶二千三百。 天寶領縣三，戶二千二百二十六，口九千九百六十四。 在京師西北五千七百二十里，東至伊州界六百八十里，南至西州界四百五十里，西至突騎施庭一千六百里，北至堅昆七千里，東至回鶻界一千七百里。
When Gaochang pacified. The twentieth year, month 4: Ashina Helu submitted; Ting for yabghu tribes. In the second year of Chang'an, Longshuo 2: Beiting Protectorate-General. Yonghui through Tianbao: Beiting 20,000 troops, 5,000 horses. Also Turgesh, Jiankun, Chuyue. Also Hanhai, Tianshan, Yiwu armies: 10,000+ troops, 5,000 horses. Jianzhong: fell to Tibetans. Formerly one county, 2,300 households. Tianbao: three counties, 2,226 households, 9,964 mouths. 5,720 li northwest of capital; borders as listed.
357
流沙州北，前漢烏孫部舊地，方五千里。 後漢車師後王庭。 胡故庭有五城，俗號「五城之地」。 貞觀十四年平高昌後，置庭州以前，故及突厥常居之。
North of Liusha; Former Han Wusun land, 5000 li square. Later Han Later Cheshi court. The old Hu court had five cities, popularly called "the land of the five cities." In the fourteenth year of Zhenguan, before Ting after Gaochang; old city and Turks dwelt here.
358
取漢輪臺為名。 海名已上三縣，貞觀十四年與庭州同置。 軍開元中蓋嘉運置，在北庭都護府城內，管鎮兵萬二千人，馬四千二百匹。 軍開元中，置西州城內，管鎮兵五千人，馬五百匹。
Named for Han Luntai. Sea name. Three counties above with Ting. Kaiyuan: Gai Jiayun army in Beiting city; 12,000 troops, 4,200 horses. Kaiyuan: army in Xi city; 5,000 troops, 500 horses.
362
在都護府南五百里。
500 li south of protectorate.
363
軍開元中置，在伊州西北五百里甘露川，管鎮兵三千人，馬三百匹，在北庭府東南七百里。 :已上十六番州，雜戎胡部落，寄於北庭府界內，無州縣戶口，隨地治畜牧。 貞觀十四年，侯君集平高昌，置西州都護府，治在西州。顯慶二年十一月，蘇定方平賀魯，分其地置濛池、昆陵二都護府。
Kaiyuan: Ganlu Creek army; 3,000 troops, 300 horses; 700 li southeast of Beiting. Sixteen fan prefectures: mixed tribes in Beiting; no registers; herding. Anxi: Hou Junji pacified Gaochang; Xi Protectorate at Xi. Eleventh month: Su Dingfang pacified Helu; Mengchi and Kunling protectorate-generals.
364
分其種落，列置州縣。 於是，西盡波斯國，皆隸安西都護府。 仍移安西都護府理所于高昌故地。 三年五月，移安西府于龜茲國。 舊安西府復為西州， 龍朔元年，西域吐火羅款塞，乃于於闐以西、波斯以東十六國，皆置都督，督州八十，縣一百一十，軍府一百二十六，仍立碑于吐火羅以志之。咸亨元年四月，吐蕃陷安西都護府。至長壽二年，收復安西四鎮，依前于龜茲國置安西都護府。 至德後，河西、隴右戍兵皆徵集，收復兩京， 上元元年，河西軍鎮多為吐蕃所陷。 有舊將李元忠守北庭，郭昕守安西府，二鎮與沙陀、回鶻相依，吐蕃久攻之不下， 建中元年，元忠、昕遣使間道奏事，德宗嘉之，以元忠為北庭都護，昕為安西都護。其後，吐蕃急攻沙陀、回鶻部落，北庭、安西無援，貞元三年，竟陷吐蕃。 本龜茲國。
Tribes divided; states and counties arrayed. West to Persia all under Anxi Protectorate. Anxi seat moved to old Gaochang. The third year, month 5: Anxi to Kucha. Old Anxi office again Xi Prefecture. Xianqing 4: Tokhara submitted; sixteen states; eighty prefectures; stele in Tokhara. Fourth month: Tibetans captured Anxi Protectorate. Zhenyuan: Four Garrisons recovered; Anxi at Kucha again. After Zhide: Hexi and Longyou troops mobilized for two capitals. In the first year of Shangyuan, Hexi garrisons mostly to Tibetans. Li Yuanzhong Beiting; Guo Xin Anxi; Shatuo and Uyghurs; Tibetans could not take. Jianzhong 3: secret memorial; Dezong made Yuanzhong Beiting Protector, Xin Anxi Protector. Afterward Tibetans attacked Shatuo and Uyghur; Beiting and Anxi without aid; fell to Tibetans. Originally Kucha state.

顯慶中，自西州移府治於此。 東至焉耆鎮守八百里，西至疏勒鎮守二千里，南至於闐二千里，東北至北庭府二千里，南至吐蕃界八百里，北至突騎施界雁沙川一千里。 安西都護府，鎮兵二萬四千人，馬二千七百匹。 都護兼鎮西節度使。 安西都護所統四鎮本龜茲國。 其王姓白，理白山之南。 去瓜州三千里，勝兵數千， 貞觀二十二年，阿史那社人小破之，虜龜茲王而還，乃於其地置都督府，領蕃州之九。至顯慶三年，破賀魯，仍自西州移安西府置於龜茲國城 本于闐國。
Xianqing: seat moved here from Xi. Distances to garrisons and borders as listed. Anxi Protectorate: 24,000 troops, 2,700 horses. Protector also Zhenxi military commissioner. Four Garrisons under Anxi originally Kucha. King surname Bai; ruled south of Mount Bai. 3,000 li from Gua; several thousand soldiers. In Zhenguan 22, Ashina She'er defeated them, captured the king of Kucha, and returned. A protectorate was then set up there over nine fan prefectures. By Xianqing 3, after Helu was defeated, the Anxi office was moved from Xi Prefecture to Kucha's capital. Originally Khotan state.
366
在蔥嶺北二百里，勝兵數千。 俗多機巧。 其王伏闍信，貞觀二十二年入朝。上元二年正月，置毗沙都督府，初管蕃州五。上元元年，分為十。在安西都護府西南二千里 本疏勒國。
200 li north of Cong Ridge; several thousand soldiers. Custom: very clever. King Fuxinxin came to court. First month: Pisha protectorate; five fan prefectures. Tianbao 2: divided into ten. 2,000 li southwest of Anxi Protectorate. Originally Shule state.
367
在白山之南，勝兵二千。 去瓜州四千六百里， 貞觀九年，遣使朝貢，自是不絕。上元中，置疏勒都督府，在安西都護府西南二千里 本焉耆國。
South of Mount Bai; 2,000 soldiers. 4,600 li from Gua Prefecture. In Zhenguan 9, they sent tribute envoys to court and continued thereafter. In the Shangyuan era, the Shule protectorate was established two thousand li southwest of the Anxi Protectorate. Originally Yanqi state.
368
其王姓龍，名突騎支，常役於西突厥。 俗有魚鱉之利， 貞觀十八年，郭孝恪平之，由是臣屬。 上元中，置都督府處其部落，無蕃州。 在安西都護府東八百里。 西域十六都督州府，西域諸國，遣使來內屬，乃分置十六都督府，州八十，縣一百一十，軍府一百二十六，皆隸安西都護府，仍于吐火羅國立碑以紀之。
King surname Long, name Tuqizhi; often subject to Western Turks. Custom: profit in fish and turtles. In Zhenguan 18, Guo Xiaoke pacified them, and thereafter they became subjects. Shangyuan: protectorate for tribe; no fan prefectures. 800 li east of Anxi Protectorate. Sixteen Western Regions protectorate offices; eighty prefectures; all under Anxi; stele in Tokhara.

于吐火羅國所治遏換城置，以其王葉護領之。 於其部內分置二十四州，都督統之
At Tokhara Ehuang city; yabghu king leads. Twenty-four prefectures within; protector supervises.

于訶達羅支國所治伏寶瑟顛城置，以其王領之。 仍於其部分置八州

At Danmo Dan city; Liyi Prefecture split.

At Humiduo Moting city.
383
於久越得犍國所治步師城置
At Jiuyuede Bushi city.
384
于波斯國所治陵城置。
At Persia Ling city.
385
:右西域諸國，分置羈縻州軍府，皆屬安西都護統攝。 自天寶十四載已前，朝貢不絕。 今于安西府事末紀之，以表太平之盛業也。
Above Western Regions states: jimi prefectures and army offices under Anxi Protector. Until Tianbao 14, its tribute missions to the court continued without interruption. Now end of Anxi account recorded to display great peace splendor.
